Luahn, aware he had seldom interacted with Radak, its creator, thought to invite him to the dinner table and deepen their bond. This also let Radak observe Luahn's unique features to recreate in the doll, including a rare but nonetheless genuine smile.

name: Reindeer Eagle, Dutiful Defender
description: Angelas, Victoire, and Eagle were also invited to Gran Verge's Christmas celebration. Of the three, Radak chose Eagle as the model for a special doll after learning he donated much of his earnings to a needy orphanage. However, the shield-bearing warrior accepted this commemorative gift without a word.

name: Jolly Bakoo Doll
description: A festive version of the popular Bakoo doll, created by Radak. It served as a base for the dolls modeled after the royal children. The originals were removed from store shelves after the calamity until Liza vouched for their innocence. Glittering decorations also gave their classic look an irresistible charm, reigniting everyone's love for them.

name: Jingle Bells
description: A blessed instrument said to be used in the celebration of an otherworld holiday called Christmas. Once a year, people young and old gather around an illuminated tree, enjoy a grand feast, and exchange presents until morning. This event has also started gaining popularity in Raktehelm as the festive decor becomes more elaborate with each passing occasion.

name: Light Relic "Miraculous Sands"
description: Long ago, a sage crafted this unique hourglass after receiving a divine revelation. As the granulated moonlight falls, it releases a portion of its immense magic, on occasion transforming whatever is in the vicinity. Whoever can master that risk will obtain a power rivaling the Gods.

name: Dark Relic "Abyssal Sands"
description: Ancient sorcery created this hourglass from fathomless darkness. As the grains fall, they absorb light's innate magic. This accumulated power bends the fabric of space-time, disguising its own constant expansion. None can even begin to predict what would happen if it were ever released.

name: Shining Buckler "Engaged Shield"
description: As the name implies, one must make a vow to this shield to receive its magical protection. Many do so before thinking about the consequences, and they later come to curse their haste. It is often said getting rid of this shield is much harder than obtaining it.

name: True "Engaged Shield"
description: The ties between shield and holder deepen with time, unlocking its true power. The metal becomes feather-light and harder than diamond. However, when the holder passes their prime, so too does the shield's protection weaken. Indeed, their vow only ends in mutual death. Many such tales exist, all of them stirring and cruel in equal measure.

name: Radiant Sword "Flaredight"
description: One of the few holy weapons made by Human hand. Along with its legendary craftsmanship, the gems embedded into the blade granted it power over time. Mastery bestows phenomenal speed, enough to cut through a bullet in flight twice. It was once stored in the armory of an imperial nobleman but has since gone missing. The fact that its popularity gave rise to numerous imitations makes finding the genuine article even more difficult.

name: Skull Helm "Dusk Roar"
description: A helmet created from the remains of the evil Villakurz. Defensive sorcery redirects its dark might to disrupt almost all outside magical influence, yet the intricate web of spells still cannot completely block the mental erosion it causes. Therefore, a strong mind is required to wear this without lasting drawbacks.

name: Void Helm "Disaster"
description: A helmet fashioned from remains steeped in the dark power of Villakurz. The high concentration of magic generates a warp in the space-time fabric to provide matchless defense. However, that warp also drains the wearer's mana, and its grim appearance is trauma-inducing. Anyone who desires this needs bottomless energy reserves and a fearless heart.

name: True "Ready Maid"
description: Serah's favorite maid dress. The fabric repels everything from water to acid, making it suitable for light housework or dangerous experiments. Professor Arcana has praised how her choice to wear an all-purpose outfit reflects a "battle-ready" mindset. However, his tendency to ask her to make dinner while she's busy has come close to actually starting battles.

name: Water Relic "Soul Lattice"
description: A shield that contains the soul of a legendary water dragon that ruled the ocean. Its heart frozen by interminable solitude survived even after its body wasted away. That frigid spirit then solidified the moisture in the air to build sturdy crystal layers. The supernatural nature of this shield grants phenomenal defense, bringing to mind how its original owner's heart also shut out the entire world.

name: Earth Relic "Cyclus Fati"
description: A bracelet found in the depths of a misty ruin. Though seeming to be made of organic materials at first glance, a closer look reveals the dense network of machinery covering the surface. Its jade aura perpetually whirls about the track to create a strange force field. A phrase in the old language meaning "Cycle of Fate" is written on the link that closes the loop, suggesting it can alter the laws of causality.

name: Fire Relic "Flaming Knight's Eyes"
description: Legendary accessories mentioned in the Bible of the Flaming Knight. Long ago, the leader of the flame spirits agreed to grant an incomprehensible strength to their wearer upon command. The Dara Desert that occupies most of Gramenia is a symbol of that power's immensity, as records imply its creation resulted from one such incident.

name: True "Wild Cat"
description: Sophie of the Firecat's Den restaurant inherited this hunting pan from her father. Thick and tough, it can serve as both a shield and a bludgeon. She wields cookware such as this in battle to show her pride as a chef, hunting not for sport but to nourish herself and others.

name: True "Wonderful"
description: Rits was given this ancestral weapon to defeat her dream rivals, and she still holds tightly to it even after waking from that dream. She felt a close connection to it from the first time she slid the bow across the strings, as if she had played it all her life. Her technique melds perfectly with her devotion to music, giving rise to numerous masterpieces.

name: Night Jacket
description: A coat made with a special lightweight textile to keep up with Batiste on his secret missions. It looks flimsier than armor, but reinforced threads and hidden plates shield him from slashing swords and piercing arrows. He has been saved on more than a few occasions thanks to this reliable article.

name: True "Night Jacket"
description: A jet-black jacket Batiste has worn for years. Crafted with a fusion of magic and technology, it allows him to completely hide his presence at night, making it essential for the rare assassination mission. People in other nations fear him as "the Black Flash", but he believes that name's very existence is proof of his inexperience as a covert operative.

name: True "Night Edge"
description: Batiste's preferred weapon, given to him personally by the emperor when he was inducted into the Zero Guard. Their coloring lets them melt into the shadows. The shape gives the impression they are meant to be thrown from a distance, but one of his physical prowess and reflexes can use them in close combat. The deadly glint as he turns them in his hand before striking is the origin of his nickname: "The Black Flash".

name: Night Walkers
description: Though these appear to be standard walking boots at first glance, their lightness and flexibility are anything but, providing perfect support for Batiste's nimble movements. The special material is impervious to the average blade and gives extra lift for superhuman jumps.

name: Night Edge
description: Knives specially made to suit the top-secret nature of many of the Zero Guard's missions. Designed for functionality and lightness, their keen edges can pierce even thick armor. Months of trial and error by the empire's top blacksmith produced these metallic masterpieces.

name: True "Hepaistos"
description: Gilliam's prized warmallet used to make the finest arms. With considerable girth and tough alloy construction, it obliterates the hardest, hottest foes. A novice solider will see a simple weighted weapon, but a true master will take full advantage of its all-purpose nature. The clear, sharp clang of red-hot steel echoing throughout Reigrad is proof of the pride he puts into his work.

name: True "Ember Bolt"
description: The bow used by Priscilla, also known as the Inferno Archer. The beautiful blaze that bursts from each arrowhead shines brighter the more emotional she is. At maximum intensity, their heat even melts steel. The skill and accuracy she demonstrated in subduing the double-headed monster that appeared in the castle garnered much praise from even the Imperial Knights.

name: Candent Bow "Ember Bolt"
description: The bow belonging to Priscilla, an archer from Simon's Hill. The fire spirit that resides in it responds to her feelings, granting each arrow only as much strength as is necessary. She hunted monsters and protected villages on her journey to the capital, and damage was kept to a minimum in each conflict. That could be credited to both her own talent and the spirit's fine tuning.

name: Blazing Boots "Ignition"
description: The footgear of Priscilla, famous archer from Simon's Hill. Their mysterious flames create heat shimmers that perplex foes, leading to embarrassing, critical mistakes on their part. She stands on the front lines because of her strong desire to protect, but it is her quick judgment and flexibility which saves her from serious harm.

name: True "Jaeger"
description: The gun carried by legendary sniper Simon. Based on Swagger & Vecket and Goldoa Corp.'s masterpiece, he tasked the best gunsmith in the empire to further refine its capabilities. It not only takes the original high-precision design concept to the next level, projectile velocity was also greatly increased. This ballistic marvel is the very embodiment of his "one shot, one kill" creed.

name: Jaeger M4A2
description: The gun carried by expert sniper Simon. A joint product between rifle-maker Swagger & Vecket and magic artificers Goldoa Corp., it was designed with a focus on accuracy. It uses standard ammunition guided by runes inscribed into the firing hammer and gun barrel. Manageable recoil also meets his high standards, letting him eliminate targets with the fewest possible shots.

name: Phantom Coat "Stigma"
description: The black overcoat worn by Simon, hero of Simon's Hill. The emperor personally bestowed it upon him in recognition of his outstanding service to the empire. In addition to its edgeproof and bulletproof qualities, the magical cloth dampens perception in others. He melts into the darkness at night, rendering him practically invisible to the untrained eye.

name: Shrieking Claws "Despair"
description: The sharp claws of a monster born from forbidden experiments. A group of Humans, obeying only their greed for knowledge, sacrificed many lives to create a new form of being. However, the outcome was far removed from their ideal, and they abandoned the hideous thing along with the facility deep underground. When it finally escaped from its metal prison, many punctures were seen in its flesh, evidence of vain attempts to take its own life.

name: True "Ouen"
description: The katana used by famed "Divine Swallow Fencer", Airi. She believes it to be her fated companion as it brings out the most of her thrusting techniques. Its tip, sharpened to the limit with Valkian whetstones, fascinates swordsmiths of all skill levels. The reason she always keeps it in prime condition is not because of its historic value, but her own pride as a soldier.

name: Traditional Blade "Ouen"
description: One of Valkia's most significant weapons. It passed between many different collectors as a high-valued antique, but few have used it in actual combat. The narrow tip makes it ideal for thrusting, but the sharp edge gives it slashing attacks that are just as strong. Airi especially likes the pattern on its sheath, so she cleans it every night before turning in.

name: Airi's Boots
description: Airi's military footwear. Despite their plain appearance, they are the sum product of Valkia's advanced magic, which was necessary to endure her nimble movements. The manner in which the vast resource investment to create them was readily approved speaks volumes about her importance to the nation's forces.

name: Divine Mercy "Silent Ritual"
description: The helmet of Palamicia, a God warrior who left her mark on history as a lifelong adherent to the sword. She was dubbed the Silent Divine for her technique as beautiful as a clear lake surface. This headgear stores her purified energy, granting the wearer miraculous powers such as instantaneously healing fatal wounds. Though remarkable, it represents a mere fraction of her strength.

name: Divine Mercy "Silent Ritual"
drop_information:
Raid Event
Fallen Beast God Palamicia Defeat Reward

name: Silent Ritual EV
description: The helmet of Palamicia, a God warrior who left her mark on history as a lifelong adherent to the sword. She was dubbed the Silent Divine for her technique as beautiful as a clear lake surface. This headgear stores her purified energy, granting the wearer miraculous powers such as instantaneously healing fatal wounds. Though remarkable, it represents a mere fraction of her strength.

name: True "Gold Rush"
description: There once lived a Bamint-born actress of matchless talent. Sharon idolizes her so much that she went through great lengths to obtain her trademark stole. Whether she is basking in applause or laboring behind the scenes, it can always been seen glimmering around her shoulders. People eventually started believing it is the sign of a top star.

name: True "Bel Canto"
description: The gun Hart uses in his rebellion against the empire. It was once the flagship product of Goldoa Corp., popular all throughout Isliid for its ease of use and high accuracy. The solid barrel, where most of its limited weight is located, ensures precision. Its report is somewhat higher pitched compared to other guns due to the metal's properties, giving it the nickname of "the Singing Gun".

name: Bel Canto M3
description: A pistol used by the magic gunner Hart. Goldoa Corp. drew upon their experience working with rifle makers Swagger & Vecket to independently manufacture this model. Designed for self-defense, it is much smaller and lighter than the Jaeger. It maintains its high accuracy even in burst-fire mode, added to make up for its reduced stopping power. Women in particular found it an attractive choice.

name: Archaic Attire "Antiqua"
description: The battle outfit Hart wears as he fights the empire. He received it from Azvan as his 11th Affiliate. Not only resistant to blades and bullets, it is remarkably effective against spells. The lightweight fabric bears not a single seam or tear, giving the impression it was created by magic or some long-forgotten technology.

name: Winged Mail "Blue Pinions"
description: Armor created from the plumage of Freydal, said to leave its shrine and scatter icy feathers over Raktehelm once every few decades. Less than a hundred of them currently exist, making it impossible to craft new coats. The feathers' unbreakable, unmelting properties extend to the wearer's mind as well.

name: Occult Wings "Rafale"
description: Armor made from the freezing magic of Freydal. On rare occasions, it leaves its nest in the otherworldly shrine and sheds indestructible icicle-like feathers across Raktehelm. This particular suit was enchanted to strengthen the Freydal's blessing, repelling any menace or disaster.

name: Scaled Branches "Aurora"
description: Vambraces made from the ancient tree limbs that cover Elpneumas. They seek a suitable owner who can contain the mystical power that gushes forth like a bottomless fountain. Any unable to do so will become overwhelmed and perish.

name: Occult Branches "Seratta"
description: Vambraces made with the ancient tree limbs that once wrapped around Elpneumas. A Demon artisan, inspired by how the energy flowing from the wood took on the dragon's power, created these after much experimentation. However, both the positive and negative effects reach beyond their wearer, so whoever joins them must also be prepared.

name: Jade Star "Le Courage"
description: The battle dress of Cestina, second princess of Gran Verge. Unwilling to compromise comfort or protection, she asked her older sister for help in creating a loom that weaves magic directly into the fabric. This is how it can grant extra protection in response to her will while sporting a breezy, sleeveless design.

name: Spectral Talon
description: A shining lance containing the power of a legendary beast. It releases enough heat to instantly vaporize any foe, but only those with immense mana reserves can satisfy its energy consumption. Folklore reveals the existence of a counterpart in the form of a dark shield, and whoever obtains both will wield the complete power of that beast.

name: Spectral Wings
description: A black shield containing the power of a legendary beast. It creates a dimensional force field that makes it impossible to physically touch the holder. Once kept in a small village as a ritual item, it vanished and the village was destroyed as a result of some unexplained phenomenon. Folklore reveals the existence of a counterpart in the form of a shining lance, and whoever obtains both will wield the complete power of that beast.

name: Hart's Waistline Headline
description: A pair of swimming trunks with a unique newsprint pattern. Vultee told Hart he needed a more enticing look if he wanted to make some real summer memories. On the other hand, the women in his life praised how it matched his well-read nature. This caused Hart to smile bashfully...and Vultee to seethe ineffectually.

name: Priscilla's Summer Stakes
description: This is the year she goes all in. She browsed countless swimsuits, pondered for days, then finally decided to pin her unspoken hopes and dreams on a timeless design that also accentuates the tenderness of the female figure. The season's liberating thrill convinced her to throw restraint to the wind and charge right out of the gate. Whether or not she will cross the finish line first is anyone's guess.

name: Vultee's Vista of Paradise
description: Vultee knows catching a big wave needs the right gear. With this stylish shirt, he can undo the buttons to reveal just enough of his sculpted physique to drive the ladies wild, or so he believed. That was until Priscilla gave him a puzzled look and asked why he suddenly couldn't dress himself properly. Ever since, he keeps all of the buttons fastened tight.

name: Simon's Nostalgic Shades
description: Simon spent most of his time at the beach reading beneath an umbrella when not training. Underneath the summer sun's glare, he always wore these tinted glasses. He may have been protecting his most important asset as a sharpshooter...or hiding his embarrassment at Miranda's shameless swimwear. No one knew for certain.

name: Miranda's Dynamite Blast
description: Among Miranda's quirks was her outlandish taste in swimwear. She had not visited the beach since Simon's passing, and a last-minute search through her wardrobe unearthed nothing but this particularly skimpy bikini. The concern that it no longer fit her, since she had bought it years ago for their first beach date, proved needless. Instead, she felt pride in seeing real proof of her successfully balancing regular training with her busy teaching schedule.

name: Luana's Seaside Fantasy
description: Luana's favorite swimsuit worn during her family's yearly trips to the beach. She chose it wanting to show Hart, but that opportunity never came. Although outgrown during his absence, she couldn't bring herself to part with it. In her mind, that would be no different than giving up entirely.

name: True "Castillo"
description: The shield belonging to Gaia, loyal knight of the Higher Gods. Imbued with the power of a water Spirit, it creates a wave barrier at the user's will. He charges across the battlefield with it firm in hand to save his allies. The beautiful, crystal-clear flash of his sword followed by the beautiful, flower-shaped splash from his shield earned him the nickname "Water Blossom Knight".

name: True "Maximus"
description: Lyla's trusty partner on the battlefield. In her quest for further improvement, she wandered into a used bookstore. There, she discovered a reference about Valkia's ancient "gundancing" custom and became engrossed in the topic. The key concept was managing the weapon's unpredictable movements with lithe motions of the body. In mastering that, she became famous among gunmen around the world.

name: Valkian Heritage "Maximus"
description: A model of gatling gun once manufactured in Valkia Kingdom. Thorough maintenance has preserved its luster against the ravages of time. The army officers chose this for Lyla after assessing her skills. Although she struggled with its weight at first, the fact she learned to wield it so well in such a short time reflects her untiring efforts to become the best she can be.

name: Combat Coat "Veste Noir"
description: Lyla's military outfit. The magic sewn into the fabric of Valkia's army uniforms affects each soldier differently. It granted her the power of light which enhances the strength of her shots. However, they all share the sturdiness to withstand the soldiers' daily regimen, so everyone treats their own as a dependable ally.

name: Flame Maiden's Satchel
description: A small red box said to have belonged to the Flame Maiden, the woman who led an adventurer lost in the underworld to safety. Containing the vital force of the phoenix A'patari, it cleansed the traveler's body and mind of those dark mists. She could hold it barehanded, but others must take precautions lest the intense heat leave burns.

name: Atlante's Fangs
description: A pair of daggers with countless miniscule Crests engraved along the blades. The water dragon motif suggests they were crafted by a tribe that worshipped the twin-headed Atlante. If swung fast enough, the Crests call forth its power through the afterimages. This means these weapons only show their true worth when wielded by a skilled warrior.

name: Glorious Decline
description: A silver staff with a large green crystal blessed by the Dragon of Life at the top. The fascinating swirls of magic inside the gem fetch a high price. Though most of the time it quickly changes hands and locations, it causes ruinous turmoil if it remains in one place for too long. People believe that its gift is beneficial to the point of harm, hence the name.

name: Halos Pragma
description: A jet-black helmet made from the scales of Mavro-halos, a monster that once threatened all of Raktehelm. Discovered in ruins ravaged by his fury, whoever touches it will be consumed by the dark blaze. Records show it was originally beautiful platinum headgear worn by knights who served the Dragon, but hatred inside the scales corroded the metal over time.

name: Halos Pragma

Fallen Beast God Mavro-halos Defeat Reward

name: Halos Pragma EV
description: A jet-black helmet made from the scales of Mavro-halos, a monster that once threatened all of Raktehelm. Discovered in ruins ravaged by his fury, whoever touches it will be consumed by the dark blaze. Records show it was originally beautiful platinum headgear worn by knights who served the Dragon, but hatred inside the scales corroded the metal over time.

name: Leone's Precious One-Piece
description: Cute swimwear belonging to Leone, princess of Granadia. Although she first hid in the shade, the listening sands and beckoning waves had coaxed her onto the beach before she knew it. Tired from playing all day, the swaying of the carriage soon rocked her to sleep beneath the warm smiles of the Templars.

name: Juno's Seafoam Pareo
description: A graceful ensemble worn by the queen of Granadia, Juno. As part of summer vacation for her Templars (minus Berwick), she decided to surprise Leone by taking her to the beach in secret. Despite a few unexpected happenings, her plan ended successfully. While watching her dear sister and her dependable guardians at play, she renewed her oath to do whatever it took to protect their smiles.

name: Blue Ray Vox
description: Camouflage-patterned swim trunks for Vox, captain of the Templars. His oath to protect Juno remained strong even during the relaxed vacation mood. Not even fun in the sun would keep him from carrying out his duties as a knight, such as rescuing the princess from roving monsters. This display of unwavering commitment also helped close the distance between the two ever so slightly.

name: Duke the Legendary
description: Swimming briefs that Riviera picked out for Duke. He gave her the chance since he has no strong preference in fashion and realized how much she was looking forward to their beach vacation. However, its gaudy, prismatic design brought instant regret. Positioned imposingly in the waist-high shallows, he reflected upon the importance of proper consideration in all things, on and off the battlefield.

name: Riviera's Sundrenched Stunner
description: The daring bikini of the Juno Templars' vanguard fighter, Riviera. She had secretly worked on her figure all year just so she could wear it without hesitation. The captivating sight of her frolicking on the white sands more than solidified her role as beauty of the group. Also, she was the only one who remembered to bring a souvenir for Berwick, earning his respect.

name: Thetis' Mikyu-Mate
description: Mikyuon-themed diving gear belonging to shield bearer of the Juno Templars, Thetis. The magical snorkel gives its wearer the power to breathe underwater, and he hoped it would let him gather rare deep-sea delicacies at their freshest. While it performed admirably in that regard, he realized most of what he found would be hard for the others to stomach. His reward was not gasps of admiration at his culinary skills but smiles of content after a satisfying meal.

name: Leone's Pretty Parasol
description: Besides blue waters and white sands underneath the yellow sun, the beach was also home to green monsters. Leone strolled along the shore, enjoying the scent of the breeze with her parasol open wide...utterly unaware a small parade had formed behind her. Though the impish creatures scared her at first, she felt a little sad to say goodbye at day's end. This little parasol is filled with memories of their time together.

name: Diever Boat 2021 Model
description: Juno's personal Diever Boat. From the moment she saw it on display, its hydrodynamic form and cute eyes stole her heart. All of the latest features are installed, allowing for realistic Diever movement that instantly responds to its driver. Those who watched her tear through the waves found her greater-than-usual exuberance charming.

name: Selfish Aria
description: A large hooded coat belonging to the founder of Riizism, Elizabeth. Although it in itself has no special powers, pulling the hood over the wearer's face will draw out their full potential through suggestive stimulus. The stretchy fabric makes it one-size-fits-all but offers little in the way of protection.

name: Liz's Curio
description: The pendant of Elizabeth, founder of Riizism. Its only notable feature is letting the wearer hypnotize themselves into releasing their full potential. The bumpy surface can massage sore feet, but it is too fragile to support one's whole body weight.

name: True "Selfish Aria"
description: The oversized coat belonging to an evil priest's first experiment, Elizabeth. It has no unique qualities besides elasticity, but it uses the power of suggestion to activate the wearer's latent capabilities. Since it was a birthday gift from her mother, she rarely takes it off. The reflective back allows her to be seen even in the dark.

name: Inspector Z4
description: Goldoa Corp.'s iconic laser gun. Lightweight, durable, and customizable down to the pulse color, it has fans among gunslingers of all skill levels. There are also "Inspector Collectors" who seek out rare versions, driving up prices on the second-hand market as a result. Some will even travel to far-flung rural shops in hopes of discovering treasure.

name: Selunian Brick Top
description: Vultee's favorite hat, a style popular among ranchers in Selunia. He firmly believes a gunner always needs a hat, so he has dozens in all shapes and sizes. The reason he prefers this particular one is the perfect balance of formal and casual provided by the broken-in fabric, suiting him to a T.

name: True "Inspector"
description: The customized weapon of Vultee, imperial soldier from Simon's Hill. Most of the visual adjustments are minor like the perfectly molded grip. Far more important are the magically strengthened gun barrel, able to withstand up to twice the output, and the precision calibration chip tuned to his personal quirks.

name: Ancient Law
description: A necklace inscribed with the text of a lost civilization. It has the power to bind and control the minds of others. A partial decoding of the script led researchers to believe it to be the code of law for an extinct race known as the Ancients. Only a handful still exist, and many are fabricated. Even so, merely imitating the shape gives them some effectiveness.

name: Nine Oaths
description: A magical dress with enchanted embroidery. It grants the wearer immense power but places a number of restricting terms on them. Moreover, no record of the consequences should those terms be broken exists. The fabric adapts to the body's contours even if it changes dramatically.

name: Dread Lotus
description: Magical boots worn by Tursowa, champion of the Ancients. They were crafted in the distant past using a spell-nullifying material, but the ones worn by Emi are imitations created with her own magic. Since she destroys them whenever she transforms, that is a more reasonable method of replacing such rare articles.

name: Kingdom's Blade "Grand Scale"
description: A sword kept in the Principality of Bamint to slay the "monsters" that occasionally emerge among the royal lineage. The only one spared from this fate was Celia, instead sentenced to lifelong imprisonment. Despite the severity of her crimes, it was believed a third party ultimately initiated her transformation.

name: True "Ancient Law"
description: Emi's necklace engraved with the script of a lost civilization. It gives her the ability to control the minds of her retainers. Unlike the waning effect found in others, the power of this one is fully intact since it was made recently.

name: True "Nine Oaths"
description: Emi's dress inlaid with enchanted embroidery. The pact she formed with it gave her strength in exchange for limiting her actions. There are nine restrictions in all, with each additional one offering a proportional benefit. Since complete commitment makes it impossible to lead a normal life, some other source of stability, such as a firm will or a deep-rooted anger, is necessary.

name: True "Grand Scale"
description: The royal blade of Bamint wielded by Rayas as last resort against the Ancients. Before reaching the principality, it was worshiped in La Riiz for reasons unknown. The will of a knight from a bygone era resides within it, made possible by the Magistones from which it was forged. When Rayas made contact with that spirit, he was taught how to release the sword's full power.

name: Despair Blade "Degil Alter"
description: A mystical sword with the soul of a rampaging Dragon that once incinerated the world. Its rushing flames can reduce an entire battalion to ashes in one stroke. A royal family kept it as a symbol of their military dominance, unaware each swing loosened its binds on the Dragon's soul and brought them ever closer to their own doom.

name: Jack-O-Sherum Summonstone
description: It is said by raising this ochre crystal skywards, Jack-O-Sherum will appear and grant the holder's wish. That pumpkin-headed armor is assumed to be possessed by Ragsherum Phantom. Although it brings no harm to people directly, the cost of asking for its aid is pranks befitting the spirit of the occasion.

name: Jack-O-Sherum's Cape EV
description: The cape of Phantom Ragsherum when it was possessed by a pumpkin ghost. Donning this, he was seen around the land, wandering through the darkness of the autumn nights. The reason as to why he would perform "tricks" on those he would encounter until he was quelled with a "treat" is still unknown. No one could see his face, as it was covered by a pumpkin, but he somehow seemed joyous when he received a treat and disappeared into the night.
drop_information:
Exploring "Lanterns to Light the World"
[Despair], [SPEX Hyper], [Limited EX]

name: Hart's Discovery
description: The town of Simon's Hill held a costume festival to celebrate the harvest each fall. For the school event, Hart's class chose to open a maid café. Hart originally volunteered to cook, but Vultee's remark of "Y'know, I think you'd look good in a dress." was met with unanimous agreement. Despite his grumbling in the changing room, he couldn't deny that thrilling sensation as he looked himself over in the mirror.

name: Priscilla's Maid Dress
description: Priscilla's maid outfit. She fell in love with the frilly design, but it merely occupied space in her wardrobe for months since there was no opportunity to wear it until the costume festival. Encouraged that it still fit her, she hoped to catch Hart's eyes, but the fact that everyone else's were focused him in a skirt left her feeling conflicted...even though she had happily applied his make-up.

name: Vultee's Dandy Duds
description: Vultee's traditional yet classy butler suit. To apologize for inadvertently causing Hart to dress like a maid, he decided to join him on the service side of the class café. However, no amount of guilt could bring him to make the leap into a skirt as well. This was why he was secretly relieved to see Hart enjoying himself regardless of everything.

name: Miranda's Relived Youth
description: A devastating (on several levels) outfit of Miranda's, said to have been fashionable in a distant country. Although she needed some time to realize the absurdly long socks were meant to be scrunched up, she claimed it made her feel rejuvenated. Indeed, more than a few visitors to the school festival assumed she too was part of the student body from her ebullience.

name: Bushido Master S
description: If Simon were still alive, Miranda would choose the garb of a far-eastern warrior for him to wear at the costume festival. He would likely heave a sigh and put it on reluctantly, but he would gradually accustom himself to the unusual blade and even strike a couple of poses... Or so she envisioned the day before the event.

name: Bouncy Bunny Luana
description: Everyone is free to pick their costume for the fall festival, so there are invariably a handful of shocking selections such as Luana's. Still, no one could work up the courage to dissuade her from wearing what was bought with her own hard-earned allowance money. The perfectly innocent reason she chose it further complicated matters: "Hart said he likes bunnies."

name: True "Astral Bolt"
description: A magic compound bow once sealed away for its sinister powers. Though no one can tell when it was made, the mechanisms responsible for its tremendous lethality cannot be recreated or analyzed by modern technology. The most fearsome attribute is how anyone who wields it even for a short time, regardless of nature or personality, will grow fiercely attached, their destructive impulses stoked beyond control.

name: Astral Bolt
description: A complex magical bow long stored within an imperial armory for its shady past only to suddenly vanish. The strength of its shots is not determined by physical might, but magical aptitude. Additionally, it will use that magic to create shadow projectiles in the absence of tangible arrows.

name: Otherlight
description: A coat worn by those who shoot or kill for a living. It increases one's ability to conceal their presence by altering the target's mind. Essentially, it causes the brain to selectively ignore visual information. However, the wearer might start to believe they are being rudely disregarded as a result.

name: True "Cypher"
description: The weapon used by the assassin Groitz, a member of Shadow. The claw-like shape is suited to his personal fighting style. The rings will form rigid blades on command but maintaining them demands a steady supply of magic. Only those with deep reserves can properly use them.

name: True "Crew V"
description: Clothes made by filtering and refining residual magic in the air. The seemingly normal fabric is anything but, its Prima Ether composition letting it to shapeshift with the wearer's body. The technology behind it was not invented by Humans, but primeval deities with a thorough understanding of the arcane.

name: Cypher
description: Elongated rings that generate solid edges when fed magical power. They are favored by assassins and others who prefer easily concealed weapons. The blades' quality is proportional to the wielder's magic capacity. Since they drain energy while active, they demand a finesse and timing different from normal weapons.

name: Crew V
description: A unique outfit made from pure magic essence by a master of technology lost to history. Despite the resemblance to regular fabric, not a single stitch or seam can be found. The ethereal nature allows it to change shape as required.

name: Vagrant
description: Groitz's boots. The soles are inlaid with crystal fragments that naturally repulse energies in the ground. This repulsion can be adjusted to do anything from muffle footsteps to leap great distances. The fact it does not expend one's own magic reserves makes them all the more convenient.

name: Shielding Edge "Will Craver"
description: An armored sword containing the power of Wilkes, half of a pair that represents the opposing forces of life and death. Long ago, she sealed light of every hue in this world inside of it creating an eternal brilliance that grants vitality to all creatures. Its holder too will obtain abundant valor leading them and their allies along the path of glory.

name: Abyss Edge "Scar Craver"
description: An armored sword containing the power of Wilkes, half of a pair that represents the opposing forces of life and death. Long ago, she sealed shadow of every shade in this world inside of it creating an ominous reminder that darkness swallows all life. Whoever holds this will gain the might to ensure victory but also the fate of perpetual solitude.

name: True "Barbatos"
description: A super-heavyweight turret gun modified for full compatibility with Vultee's prosthetic arm. Unsparing focus on firepower meant anything that resembled a safety device was stripped away. Without his strength-boosting arm, it would pose only slightly less risk to him than the target. The fact he went through so much trouble to properly wield it proves his commitment.

name: Barbatos Mk. II
description: The largest class of portable turret gun. Originally developed to installed at a fixed location, it was later miniaturized for quick repositioning. Even so, firing it unmounted is nearly impossible without superhuman strength. Vultee can only handle it due to the enhanced power output of his prosthetic arm.

name: Selunian Stormers
description: Military boots created in Selunia. They are sturdy enough to give extra anchoring for Vultee's massive weapon while flexible enough for quick movements. Their high performance even shocks expert shoemakers in the capital, and reproducing a fraction of it takes too much effort for most imitators. He has sworn by them ever since he chose to pursue a career as a marksman.

name: Giltsole Boots
description: Coming Soon!

name: True "Sky Light"
description: A sword gleaming bright enough to overwhelm the power of the divine. A God forged it to subvert the Ancient-established order. After fulfilling that purpose, it was given to the Original Human and thus passed down through the unbroken imperial Isliid lineage. Now, Humans revere it as a symbol of fearlessness against seemingly superior foes.

name: True "Terra Master"
description: A legendary sword that grants its wielder the ability to read minds, leading them to victory. Despite its fame, the details of its creation and whereabouts are lost to history. Among the few known facts is how it was bestowed to the first emperor of Isliid who decimated the opposing Human faction with its power overnight.

name: True "Dark Bringer"
description: A sword brimming with dark energy that contains the soul of a trapped apparition. Long ago, demons used it to fight others of their kind drunk with power with the help of oppressed Humans. This weapon they created together represented their joint effort. Unfortunately, it was not enough to overcome the racial barrier for long, and it ironically came into the hand of a Human emperor who slew countless more Demons.

name: Sky Light Replica
description: A copy of Sky Light, the Sword of Coruscation. The Emperor of Isliid's three blades must be sealed at all times outside of combat, and even imitations are used during ceremonies. The lone exception is the coronation rite due to a customary belief they decide their bearer and thus the nation's master. As a result, some people joke that the true rulers of Isliid are the swords themselves.

name: Terra Master Replica
description: A copy of Terra Master, the Sword of Control. While inferior to the original, the edge is still incredibly keen, and it has been enchanted with near-weightlessness. Long symbolizing the Human race's ability to forge the future, it is most synonymous with imperial might among the emperor's three blades.

name: Dark Bringer Replica
description: A copy of Dark Bringer, the Sword of Conquest. Although a Human-made imitation, the bafflingly morbid acts of the artificers, driven insane by its beauty, befit the ominous original. Even the master blacksmith who oversaw the forging process crushed both of his eyeballs to make the final touches.

name: Joyful Santa Hart
description: A doll modeled after the young magician Hart. During his research of an otherworld holiday called "Christmas", he learned about an old man in bright red clothes who delivered gifts and spread good will all over the land. This inspired him to do the same one day, dressing his doll in the magnanimous figure's outfit as a reminder of that goal.

name: Sweet Snow Priscilla
description: A doll modeled after Priscilla, an innocent archer. One wintery day some years ago, she and Hart built a snowman together. His broad smile at their handiwork still shines bright in her memory. That tender emotion is imbued in the doll she made, giving it a magical warmth.

name: Dauntless Reindeer Vultee
description: A doll modeled after the suave gunman, Vultee. When Miranda assigned the dollmaking project to her class, he immediately stood up and declared his would be the coolest. All of his schoolmates thought it was another of his usual bluffs, but the glossy red nose and exquisite horns reminded them he can do whatever he puts his mind to (sometimes).

name: Warm Santa Miranda
description: A doll based on teacher and Ranger Captain, Miranda. A lover of festivals, she had the class make plushies as room decorations for an otherworld holiday called "Christmas". Although the end-of-the-year rush meant she could not finish hers until the night before, the burning desire to see her students' smiling faces sustained her through the chill of the late hours.

name: Nostalgic Santa Simon
description: A doll modeled after Miranda's late husband, Simon. After finishing her own doll, she thought it would be appropriate to make his as well. The idea of giving him reindeer features was soon discarded in favor of a matching look. She chuckled to imagine how embarrassed he would be as she worked the needle and thread.

name: Dreaming Luana Doll
description: A doll modeled after the precocious Luana. With surprising dexterity, she crafted something that certainly did not look like the work of a child. Vultee and the others started brainstorming ways to make enough to sell, but she just pouted in the corner, never wanting anything more than Hart's praise.

name: Winter Wonderland
description: A decoration used in an otherworld festival known as "Christmas". Inside the crystal sphere is a miniaturized scene of Raktehelm, and shaking it recreates gentle snowfall. The small but captivating sight can provide entertainment for hours on end. A member of the Reigrad Adventurers' Guild is known to be particularly vulnerable to its charms.

name: Genocider's Helm
description: Unique headgear with the power of Emi's Revelation form. Despite the alluring lilac gleam, it chars skin, corrodes bone, and blinds the eyes of its wearer. However, descendants of the Ancients experience no drawbacks whatsoever. The gemstone in the center also amplifies dark magic, making it invaluable to wielders of offensive spells.

name: Genocider's Helm
drop_information:
Raid Event
Fallen Beast God Emi Defeat Reward

name: True "Assault Architect"
description: The magic wand of famous conjurer Selia. The crystal at the top, made up of highly endothermic materials, approaches temperatures close to absolute zero. This increases the strength of ice magic by a magnitude of over 1000%. However, the uninitiated should never touch it as a single mistake could leave them frozen solid.

name: Genocider's Helm EV
description: Unique headgear with the power of Emi's Revelation form. Despite the alluring lilac gleam, it chars skin, corrodes bone, and blinds the eyes of its wearer. However, descendants of the Ancients experience no drawbacks whatsoever. The gemstone in the center also amplifies dark magic, making it invaluable to wielders of offensive spells.

name: True "Asteroid"
description: A dagger crafted especially for Rosetta. The layout of the engraved runes has been customized for sharper reactions to her commands. Though its magic is fairly weak, the improved tracking and speed allows it to strike vital spots with deadly accuracy. The blacksmith who reworked the dagger used his knowledge of Shinobi culture and weaponry as a reference.

name: Vibrant Edge "Asteroid"
description: A dagger with finely engraved runes across the blade. When thrown, rune magic will activate upon striking the target. The rarity of this technique combined with its wide range of effect easily catches opponents unawares. It can also return to the wielder mid-flight for a relentless string of attacks.

name: Mana Recycler
description: A cloak made to contain magical power. Spellcasters must concentrate to have energy ready for use, but this also causes inevitable seepage. The inner lining keeps such loss to a minimum by redirecting it back into the body.

name: Mana Messenger
description: Gloves engraved with runes. When charging staves or blades with magic, even masters will experience rare instances of misfiring. These remove that risk by ensuring a perfectly stable flow. As this not only makes producing the spell's intended effect easier but also amplifies it slightly, they are very popular.

name: Fortress Armor "Geoplate"
description: Armor made from the skin of the blue Giant, Geo Zagnus. Frequently described as "tough but weighty", evading with it will quickly tire out the wearer. However, those who focus on offense find its heft gives extra momentum to each blow. After effortlessly overpowering their foes, their appraisal changes to "tough and weighty".

name: True "Heroic Path"
description: Charlotte's trusty weapon. The Scarlet Mana Stone worked into the blade glows brightly in response to its holder's spirit. Both her prestigious bloodline and intense training allows the sword to glow an even brighter red. She was inspired to become a hero from the moment she grasped the hilt, but she knows months and years of committed effort will be needed for her to reach her goal.

name: Heroic Path
description: A two-handed sword imbued with the power of light and flame. Once stored in the kingdom's treasury, an aged soldier took it with permission and lent it to his granddaughter. Each swing creates a blazing stream for attacks which are difficult to dodge and fatal upon direct contact. Many who witness the girl wrapped in the weapon's fire say she resembles its proper owner, the Hero of Famelle Zeorg, in his younger days.

name: Long-Eared Crown
description: Rabbit-shaped headgear belonging to Charlotte. It absorbs magic energy in the air to relieve the wearer's fatigue. Many believe this is what lets her wield a sword the size of her body with ease. However, she keeps it on even outside of battle for the simple reason that she likes bunnies.

name: Blaze Fan "Magnigate"
description: Created from the Flogassa's tailfeathers. Since that enormous bird lives deep inside a volcano, the source of its heat is underground magma rather than anything artificial. As a result, each swing of this makes an incinerating gust that can dissolve even a flame-resistant behemoth.

name: Blaze Fan "Magnigate"

name: True "Mukudori"
description: A pair of short swords used by Mizuki the Twelfth. They were formerly owned by an assassin on the mainland, satisfying his desire to break away from conventional shinobi designs. Both produce a high-pitched sound when swung, and the beautiful harmony that results earned them the nickname of "Resonant Blades".

name: True "Hell's Throat"
description: The enormous blade of Imari Village's historic protector, Ginzo. Glowing faintly violet in the darkness, it is rumored to have been made from the larynx of the netherworld's guardian beast. Its magic flows through the holder's nerves, creating a link that gives Ginzo compete control over its movements. This and his phantasmal stealth makes him capable of untold destruction.

name: Resonant Blades "Mukudori"
description: A pair of daggers found at an import store in the capital and modified into shinobi weapons by an Imari Village blacksmith. Able to be used separately or combined into a single double-edged sword, they are highly suited to Mizuki's style of rapid, flowing attacks. He is familiar with every kind of shinobi weapon, but these are the only ones he carries at all times.

name: Shinobi Gear "Paaka"
description: An outfit created with sewing techniques originating beyond Imari Village. Although they revere tradition, the village youth are also quick to adopt new culture. This style of hooded jacket represents that subtle change. What it lacks in defense is offset by fashion -- fresh enough to blend into modern society while still able to hide standard chain mail underneath.

name: Ebbing Katana "Hell's Throat"
description: The cursed blade carried by the legendary shinobi Ginzo. Imari Village houses several weapons forbidden to all but their elite warriors. This is the most heinous, as its cursed might amplifies one's murderous intent. Fighting Ginzo while he holds it is unfathomably dangerous, and only Mizuki dares to face them both.

name: Oni Attire "Shikoh"
description: Ginzo's armor draped in the surcoat of a warrior who died with unfulfilled ambitions. Its mystical energy amplifies his own might in addition to gradually improving the shell underneath, matching pace with advancements in combat technology. Tradition still plays an important role, however, as Imari's dyeing methods mask the metal's sheen to let it blend into shadow.

name: Stronghold Armor "Geocradle"
description: Armor crafted from the hide of Geo Zagnus, Giant master of the Gobls. It contains his innate might, granting the wearer dramatically increased brawn but reportedly making them prone to attacks by his vengeful servants. Despite these curse-like consequences, the power-hungry still desire its strength.

name: True "Tenchi Raimei"
description: Gauntlets that show outstanding mastery in one of Demonkind's oldest martial arts, Kongou Tenchi-Ryu. Influenced by strength of spirit rather than body, they become heavier the more Thetis relies upon brute force. On the other hand, he gains the speed to unleash twenty ground-splitting punches in one second with a clear, selfless mind.

name: True "Noble Gash"
description: A scythe created from Riviera's blood. Because of her connection to Juno and Leone, it also contains their Crimson Blood. It changes shape according to her will, allowing for tricky attack patterns. The sound of it slicing through the air resembles a melancholic howl, perhaps giving voice to Riviera's agony as she searches for the royal sisters.

name: Tenchi Raimei
description: Special gauntlets bestowed upon experts of Kongou Tenchi-Ryu. Very few can make them since the method is only passed down along the craftsmen living near the style's original dojo. It is believed the process harkens all the way back to the age of Ancients, the original form unmistakable beneath the changes brought about by time's passage.

name: Tenchi Shojin
description: Greaves used among practitioners of Kongou Tenchi-Ryu. Whoever can overcome the weight will gain immense strength. Their hardness not only repels blades, it shatters them. Those worn by Thetis are relatively light, but when Rayas picked one up, he was so surprised he dropped it. The impact left a hole in the floor.

name: Noble Gash
description: A scythe created from the blood of Demons. Although it has a soul, it is more of a monster than a living creature. It absorbs the blood of each holder to reform itself and become stronger, thus attracting more powerful warriors. Moreover, it directs the wielder into battle for the purpose of protecting them just enough that they realize their own weakness, making them more dependent on the sinister weapon.

name: Mortal Scarlet
description: An exceptionally resistant dress containing dense magic power. Its defense against blades and sorcery is due to the great amount of Demon blood dyeing the threads. This method was widely forbidden, including in Granadia. The blood's thickness and royal status increases effectiveness, so only a truly dire tragedy could have made this outfit's creation possible.

name: True "Hyakka"
description: Legendary kunai knives, their full potential awakened by Sakuya's mastery. Each and every one is imbued with Imari's unique magic, offering a variety of deadly effects to match her needs in battle. The number of kunai a shinobi can fling at once is said to represent their ability, and she releases dozens in a single throw.

name: Blooming Edges "Hyakka"
description: Kunai knives favored by Sakuya the Kasumi of Imari Village. The shinobi's astounding physical capabilities let them leap freely through the air, throwing these to disorient the enemy. The hapless victims' bloodspray resembles petals, granting these weapons their name. Sakuya wields them with the most expertise of everyone in the village.

name: Shinobi Scarf "Mafura"
description: Imari Village's recreation of an imported article. It grants resistance against mind-altering spells, making it useful on secret missions to lower the risk of hypnosis, brainwashing, and charms. Regardless of that, the design is extremely popular among young people, and traders outside the village will pay handsomely for it.

name: Super Spiker
description: Regulation-size equipment for beach battleball, a combination of volleyball and martial arts. The maker claims it can withstand the weight of a dragon. Some joke about building castle walls with them, but the same super-tough ore used in barriers and ramparts is mixed into the flexible coating. Getting hit by one seriously hurts.

name: Ces' Sandy Blossom
description: A swimsuit with a design inspired by tropical flowers. Cestina purchased it on impulse only to realize how skimpy it was after returning home. She hid it deep inside her wardrobe, but a sudden change of heart struck her moments before departure. That delay while she ran back to the castle gave her siblings reason enough for teasing along the journey.

name: Super Douser
description: A pump-action water gun popular among the young and the young-at-heart. This year's model boasts more capacity and faster pressurization for longer, wetter battles. *Mikyuons not included.

name: Liza's Mature Look
description: This bikini is a popular choice for young women who have never worn one before. Besides the classic design, comfortable fit, and cute ribbons, the top is enchanted with a back-stretching spell to make the wearer look ever-so-slightly taller. Liza, after nearly an hour's deliberation, became its latest customer.

name: Orvell's Royal Flare
description: Fireworks invented by Orvell with the simple intent of making huge explosions in the night sky. The launcher is small enough to carry one-handed, but it releases a massive fireball once ignited. Still under development when summer vacation began, the results were satisfactory enough to move on to the production stage. The name, however, is being kept intact.

name: Luahn's Wabi-Sabi Jams
description: A new fashion label started with the concept of making trendy yet traditional designs for young men, such as these shorts. Though it has considerable resiliency, it does not quite hold up to the rigors of beach battleball -- something Luahn discovered first-hand. When interviewed after the tournament, he said, "I never expected it would split open in the back like that..."

name: Angelas' Sweet & Saucy
description: An exotic swimsuit Angelas obtained from a shady, high-pressure market peddler. She regretted the purchase for a few days until finally working up the courage to wear it. Not only did she think it looked cute on her, so did everyone she showed it to. More than improving her mood, that attention went straight to her head.

name: Victoire's Victory
description: A bold and aggressive bikini that accentuates the wearer's natural physique. Simply putting it on gives one the poise and manner of a top model. In Victoire's case, who already had a figure sculpted by proper posture and breathing methods, there is no more fitting swimwear.

name: Airsenal Shell
description: An inflatable raft for two. The stability and comfort its large size offers makes it perfect for floating on the waves, but it needs a lot of time and air to fill. Eagle was silently flattered they borrowed the shape of his shield for the design, but he was unamused by the turtle-like caricature.

name: Magisteel-Toe Boots
description: Hart's favorite pair of boots. Their standard appearance belies a special composition designed for mages. Its magically charged laces feed the gravity-control spell in the soles for extra agility, or they can be wrapped around the wearer's arms for a boost of energy. However, his first attempt at the latter saw him immediately trip over the loosened flaps, so he never did it again.

name: Evil Pauldrons "Narcragen"
description: Once worn over the shoulders of Ragsherum, first general of the Demon forces. They create a sound like howling wind in response to the wearer's fury, striking fear into their enemies. The exact source of this noise is unclear. Some believe it is Ragsherum's ghost who died in anger, lamenting his own foolishness.

name: True "Seafoam Pareo"
description: Juno's vivid pareo-style bikini, only slightly altered. She tried it on one year later, and the strange snugness sent a chill down her spine. It was impossible she gained weight; her daily routine included an hour of rigorous exercise. Then, she remembered Riviera would be a reliable source of information on the matter. That struggle to regain composure made it clear she forgot some Demons were exceptionally late bloomers.

name: True "Precious One-Piece"
description: Leone's cute leotard-style swimsuit, unaltered in any way. She tried it on one year later, and the comfortable fit sent a chill down her spine. It was impossible she had not grown; her daily snack included a glass of nutritious milk. Then, she remembered her sister would be a reliable source of information on the matter. That glimmer of hope in her eyes made it clear she was unaware of what disappointment the future held.

name: True "Shooting Star"
description: A legendary sword made of super-lightweight meteoric iron. Zeorg chose it for Valerie after taking note of her amazing agility. Since she is already able to swing it three times in a single breath, he believes she can eventually attack ten times in the blink of an eye.

name: Shooting Star
description: A historic blade of Famelle, kept in Zeorg's collection. Despite its incredible firmness, it can float on water due to the lightweight meteoric iron used to make it. It is possible to swing this blade thrice in the same time needed to swing a regular blade once. Simply following such speed with the eyes is a superhuman feat, so whoever fights its wielder can expect a swift death.

name: Studded Heart
description: Valerie's favorite choker. Its look is both fashionable and slightly rebellious, pairing well with her usual outfit. The designer has become popular as of late, so even older articles like this fetch a high price among fans. That she managed to get a jump on the trend shows attention to surroundings in contrast to her apparent indifference.

name: Charlotte's Pure Ruffles
description: A bright pink swimsuit Charlotte chose for the summer. Though she did like the balance between the cute frills and mature shaping, Valerie's alarming enthusiasm was the main factor. It caused her to reflect on how Valerie influenced most of her wardrobe, but as long as her best friend was happy, she didn't mind.

name: Valerie's Sentimental Skirt
description: A white dress Valerie chose for the summer. She tended towards the casual style of shirts and pants, but Charlotte pressured her into a more feminine look. Its breeziness was a bit uncomfortable, but as she watched the long hem twirl around her legs in the mirror, she began to understand the appeal.

name: Forte's Gothic Straps
description: Forte's one-piece swimsuit with a starkly somber design. Her soldiers, assuming the boutique clerk forced the purchase, were flabbergasted when she said it was her own decision. That contrast between the adornments and her stoic nature further enhanced the appeal. Everyone even started imagining what the rest of her private attire might look like.

name: Emi's Smooth Streamline
description: Literal no-frills swimwear belonging to Emi. In her home village, all children were given swim lessons along with simple, practical equipment. She boasted about its superiority over the "garish Human eyesores", but her mind seemed to change moments after stepping onto the beach. Surrounded by women in a variety of colorful styles, she muttered something about being cold and wrapped a jacket around her drooped shoulders.

name: Groitz's Grotesque Trunks
description: Groitz's repulsive beach shorts. Although he clearly liked the sickly shade of green and creepy skull-and-thorn pattern, everyone else on the beach gave him a wide berth. Emi observed he would be useful in opening a path through the homeward-bound crowds, but that benefit did not outweigh the humiliation of being seen in his company.

name: Oracle Veil
description: Outerwear belonging to the Ranger Captain of Simon's Hill, Miranda. The threads are spun from blessed Oracle Flowers, granting it resistance to magic. It was a birthday present from her husband Simon. Since the Oracle Flower symbolizes trust, it made an ironic choice in light of how he would later murder her...or perhaps he hoped to avoid needing to do so.

name: True "Soaring Z"
description: The ever-reliable partner of Cosmo, Bamint officer and rising star. It transforms her outflowing emotions into killer riffs. Although Kane insists he would never give away such an expensive article, he does not seem too concerned about her borrowing it for so long. This might be because he knows she has become good enough to form a true bond.

name: Soaring Z
description: The electric guitar used by Bamint officer and novice musician Cosmo. It was part of Kane's collection, but fate brought it into her hands. According to him, it requires more than technique to play well. When she asked what else was needed, he said the answer would come if she let emotion guide her playing.

name: Beast Steel "Trance Frenzy" Replica
description: A famous weapon said to awakens one's inner animal, dramatically increasing their capabilities. Although that effect as well as its edge is inferior to the original, it is far from cheap. Its production was as faithfully recreated as possible by a living legend of metallurgy. This resulted in an unmistakable masterpiece, replication or not.

name: Beast Steel "Trance Frenzy" Custom
description: A famous weapon said to awakens one's inner animal, dramatically increasing their capabilities. To be precise, it is a reproduction crafted by a living legend among smiths. After developing a new technique, he used it to reforge his greatest works including this blade. Rumors claim the improvements have made it even sharper than the original.

name: True "Euthanasia"
description: Throwing blades favored by the secretary-general of Gramenia, Fen. His outstanding technique and myriad accomplishments have made everyone all but forget these are borrowed from the national treasury. The amount of blades increases in proportion to the user's magic power, and in his hands, they number over a thousand.

name: Shrewd Cloak "Einweiser"
description: The battle outfit of Gramenia's chief strategist, Fen. Military personnel don a uniform according to their position, and a secretary-general normally wears light gear similar to a civil officer as they do not see much combat. However, since he designed the nation's strategical maneuvers around leaders directly participating in battle, he made major customizations with tear-resistant fabric and shock-absorbing material.

name: True "Garuda"
description: Kirisame's blade possessed by a fire oni. One of Imari Village's historic weapons, a prospective user must undergo a deadly trial to hold it. The first success was attributed to the challenger somehow forming a pact with the oni. Further evidence was provided by others claiming to have witnessed the oni's figure in the flickering flame after a fierce battle.

name: Kingblade "Garuda"
description: Kirisame's weapon, containing the power of a legendary flame oni. Its internal heat repels all chill, earning the alias of "the Melting Sword", but that requires the holder to provide it with magic energy, otherwise it appears like an ordinary blade. Once ignited, each swing leaves streaks of fire, and it can evaporate weaker monsters without making contact.

name: Shinobi Shoes "Sunika"
description: Shoes from the outside world recreated with traditional Imari Village techniques. Their incredible heat resistance allows the wearer to walk over lava without feeling a thing, but the comfortable fit and firm grip are decidedly more appealing features. As their popularity took hold of the village, a wide variety of colors also sprung up.

name: True "Tenrui-Giri"
description: One of the treasures of Imari Village. It is not a shinobi invention, but a gift from an ancient emperor. Although the edge is so keen that it can purportedly slice falling raindrops, such a feat requires decades of training. Its wielders already stepped away from active combat by the time they reached that level, and Hakuro is no exception.

name: Yokai Sickle "Bloody Mikazuki" Replica
description: A sickle and weighed chain crafted in the age of myth by a conjurer using body parts from Ugetsu. Its powerful hex brought about an entire nation's downfall, causing the creator to throw it into an active volcano out of repentance. Many historians question how that series of events occurred before Ugetsu's defeat, but this imitation certainly exists and is dangerous enough even without the original's curse.

name: Yokai Sickle "Bloody Mikazuki" Custom
description: A sickle-and-chain modeled after the one made from the body of Ugetsu. Although the original article is presumed lost, a descendant of its creator attempted to replicate it from the scant surviving records. Millenia of industrial advancements and experience resulted in a technically superior product, but there was no substitution for the hex of yore.

name: Shinobi Guard "Hojo"
description: A protector built for extreme lightness. Most of its scant weight is centered around vital points. This suits a shinobi's focus on evasion and swift strikes, but those who try to use it like normal armor will be painfully disappointed. When worn by Hakuro, the elder of Imari, he can react to any incoming blow with ease.

name: Hidden Dragon "Tenrui-Giri"
description: The most prestigious weapon in Imari's history. Age has given it pseudo-divine qualities which generate an oppressive aura in battle. Only the proven are allowed to wield it, so Hakuro still does even in his retirement. However, it is a matter of time until someone takes it off his hands, and whoever does will assuredly become a legend in their own right.

name: Rusty Waitress Marika
description: The outfit Marika wore while helping out at the festival's costume cafe. It combined exotic patterns with familiar frills. Unaccustomed to taking orders, brewing tea, setting tables, and even dealing with a skirt, she was as out of her element as one could be. Regardless, the sight of timid eyes peeking over her frames captured the hearts of more than a few customers.

name: Field Medic Forte
description: The outfit Forte wore while tending to overenthusiastic revelers at the costume festival. Fresh from her debut in a fashionable swimsuit, she gained the courage to step further away from the norm. The classic nurse's cap and lace-strewn dress may have seemed excessive, but fantasy was the order of the day. This applied to many of the so-called victims as well, who faked injuries as an excuse to catch a glimpse of her.

name: Fantom Filcher Fen
description: The outfit Fen wore the night of the costume festival. His friend, boss, and general pain-in-the-rear President Kane ordered him to choose one out of a predetermined lineup. The irritation faded when he put on this stylish suit, agreeing with Kane's fashion sense. It certainly paired well with his trademark smirk, as everyone who saw him could attest.

name: Ruffhousing Lotte
description: Charlotte's werewolf outfit for the costume festival. She thought the beastly cap and long, fluffy tail made for a perfect balace of tough and cute. However, her innate childishness tipped the result far towards the cute side, and Valerie wasn't going to ruin the magic by telling her.

name: Magical Muscles Valerie
description: A witch-like outfit Valerie wore for the costume festival. It is based on the main character of a famous puppet show in Famelle. Although targeted at young children, plenty of people outside that age range appreciate its rich lore and complex characters. Since Valerie was secretly a fan, she needed less convincing from Charlotte than usual.

name: Shepherd of Isliid
description: A dignified outfit Emperor Isliid wore for the costume festival. Though resembling a cleric's vestiments, it is actually a special uniform for communicating with his ancestors. This means it is rarely used, but the night he watched over the festival from his castle was one such occasion. Whether impressed by the people's passion, harboring some secret purpose, or merely acting on a whim, no one else knows.

name: True "Enmon Zanketsu"
description: Coming Soon!

name: Enmon Zanketsu
description: Coming Soon!

name: Simmering Mantle
description: Coming Soon!

name: Fleetfire Greaves
description: Coming Soon!

name: True "Jurai"
description: A legendary weapon of the shinobi that rent the flesh of a lightning beast and once laid guarded for generations. Decades ago, Imari was beset by disastrous lightning strikes, feared to be brought about by the vengeful beast's spirit. However, a certain young girl's mastery of it brought the destruction to a halt. It allowed her to achieve great feats, earning her praise as the "Shinigami of Imari".

name: Chainblade "Jurai"
description: A legendary shinobi weapon said to have pierced a holy creature of lightning. One tale holds that the electrical power within the blades lets it reach blinding speeds. Properly wielding it requires exceptional stamina, sharp perception, and most importantly, superb cleverness. As such, it laid unused in Imari for generations until the prodigy Hazuki mastered it at the tender age of six.

name: Shinobi Haori "Gaun"
description: A coat based on an imported design woven with original Imari techniques. Strong and durable despite its light weight and softness. Furthermore, its resistance to the elements and ease of customization make it popular amongst younger shinobi.

name: Ever Flash "Fon Cruz" Replica
description: Coming Soon!

name: Ever Flash "Fon Cruz" Custom
description: Coming Soon!

name: True "Mercurius"
description: Coming soon!

name: Sainted Staff "Mercurius"
description: Coming soon!

name: Sagacious Robe "Cathedral"
description: Coming soon!

name: Red Flame Idol
description: One of three masterpieces by a famous carver. There was once a fire maiden who used her power for the benefit of mankind. So she would always remain with them, she poured the last of her strength into a scarlet crystal, which he later crafted into her shape. Whoever holds this statue will gain unshakable courage that burns bright even in the face of death.

name: Blue Drop Idol
description: One of three masterpieces by a famous carver. When a beloved priestess sacrificed herself to appease a water dragon's wrath, the tears of her admirers were gathered and crystallized. The carver, captivated by the priestess' pure heart, fashioned the crystal in her image as a memento. Whoever holds it will be wrapped in her affection, deeper than the ocean, and defended from all hardship.

name: Green Leaf Idol
description: One of three masterpieces by a famous carver. It is modeled after a mysterious fairy who would scatter faintly shining dust to guide lost wanderers out of her forest. He visited it in hopes of catching a glimpse of her, but the most he was able to find was a petrified chunk of her dust, used to make this statue. Enchanted by his strong admiration for the fairy, anyone who holds it will do so with similar tenacity.

name: Innocent Santa Lotte
description: A present from Valerie to apologize for their argument over the existence of Santa Claus. Although Valerie is skilled at embroidery, dollmaking is a different story. It took her six attempts to finish something good enough to give away. During the process of trial-and-error, she became so attached to the design that she created a seventh for herself in secret.

name: Thoughtful Santa Valerie
description: A present from Charlotte to apologize for their argument over the existence of Santa Claus. Knowing Charlotte's lack of sewing talent, she fearfully unwrapped the package only to be stunned by its high quality. Seeing how much heart and soul her friend put into it, she was motivated to improve herself.

name: Lethargic Snow Marika
description: A doll Serah created for her. Sensitive to extreme temperatures, she rarely strays from the warmth of the heater during winter. Serah consequently imagined her as a snowman in jest, but the rotund design was taken as a suggestion to exercise more. After seeing her displeasure, Serah bluntly remarked, "I'm surprised you care that much about your appearance."

name: Serving Serah Doll
description: A product of her recent dollmaking fixation. She originally planned to create ones for Marika, Serkro, and herself, but the sudden need to add Arcana left her with a shortage of material. This was resolved by designing Serkro to scale. However, he was so shocked at his miniscule size that he refused to open his mouth(?) for a while.

name: Restless Reindeer Arcana
description: After learning about the otherworld saint Santa Claus, he became obnoxiously excitable. Every evening, he would share his vast knowledge of him to anyone who would (or wouldn't) listen. Every morning, he wailed that there was no present waiting for him. Unsure about the size and position for his stocking, he called emergency meetings with Serah. Her frustration at these and other annoyances convinced her to make this doll for him and restore peace, hence the strangely ominous aura.

name: Yule Staff "Mercrimus"
description: Cestina, knowledgeable in otherworld festivals, decorated Mercurius with bright colors and gave it a matching name. Though Orvell made a face like she committed sacrilege, and Liza was dumbfounded that she'd mess with her weapon, Cestina felt justified. Not only did it show how much she treasured their reunion, she also noticed Liza sometimes mispronounced "Mercurius" in the very same way.

name: Sinful Guards "Fathomless" Replica
description: Bracers made from Giaveil the Grand Prince of Sin's body that dramatically increase the wearer's magic. As imitations containing only 3% of his body tissue, their effect is weaker than the originals, but raising that percentage with current techniques would render them uncontrollable. Regardless, these are considered among the strongest sorcery-enhancing gear available, demonstrating the Great Six Demons' absurd might.

name: Sinful Guards "Fathomless" Custom
description: Bracers made from Giaveil the Grand Prince of Sin's body that dramatically increase the wearer's magic. The standard 3% body tissue concentration in other replicas was increased to 10% by crafting them within an enchanted force field. Though some hold great expectations for this new technology, others worry placing such power in the hands of individuals may have severe consequences.

name: Golden Shrine Idol
description: Coming Soon!

name: Violet Murk Idol
description: Coming Soon!

name: Fathomless Guard "Phantom Pain"
description: The shoulder portions of Ragsherum Phantom. After the death of Demon general Ragsherum, the armor he wore was possessed by his combat techniques and obsession for conquest. Should it find a new owner, they would obtain the power and love within those metal fittings -- a detestable wicked power and a love akin to malediction.

name: True "Yamata"
description: A pair of claws wielded lovingly by the wandering Demon Long. Once holy weapons, he modified them with cursed scarlet gems born from the belly of a Dragon. Even one of those is enough to potentially corrupt the heart, so only the most resilient minds can bear their immense strength.

name: Coldsteel Claws "Yamata"
description: A pair of claws that responds to the negative emotions of its bearer. Such weapons normally rely upon weight driven by physical strength, yet these were crafted with featherlight metal to facilitate magical flow for appalling deadliness. The user's grudges, envy, and hatred further sharpen the edges, allowing them to induce even more pain and suffering.

name: Cerulean Platemail "Wrathscale"
description: A fine coat of armor produced by combining proven western smithing techniques with eastern cultural influences. Its origins may trace back to a skilled Demon blacksmith from a powerful trading kingdom of old.
