Once lost behind the Great Seal at the end of the Ancient War, a certain adventurer's actions led to the return of this splendid article, offering key historical insight.

name: Glacial Flail "Dawn Devastator" Replica
description: An imitation of the legendary mace which held Stiria's power. So that she is still present in some fashion, the sphere is wrapped in her never-melting ice. This both grants it exceptional hardness and the ability to freeze wounds, thereby slowing the healing process. Replica or not, it is no less a masterpiece.

name: Glacial Flail "Dawn Devastator" Custom
description: Modeled after a legendary mace that contained the power of Stiria. Unlike other imitations, the frigid mass contains a sheet of ice shorn from the floating glacier she rides. As a result, it boasts incomparable toughness and destructive force, but mastering the weight requires extraordinary stamina.

name: Miranda's Adolescence
description: A satchel Miranda once carried as a student. Although she is now more accustomed to a sword and shield, the fact she still owns this weathered bag proves its sentimental value. The heavy steel plate hidden inside for self-defense corrected more than a few delinquents back in the day. Perhaps that is why she is so attached to it.

name: Miranda's Fantabulous Cloak
description: A cloak that Miranda wore as a student. Now considered vintage, back then it was the latest style. Her tendency to describe it with painfully passé lingo puts to rest any concerns about making students think she is starting a new trend.

name: Priscilla's Cupid Brand
description: The charm carved into the bow keeps the target from moving. The enchantment cast upon the arrows sets the target's heart alight with passion. Nothing is required to use them except a pure heart, and they will link two souls forever. At least, that is the backstory Priscilla invented.

name: Priscilla's Dreamy Apron
description: The apron worn by the servers at a popular restaurant. Fashioned by world-renowned designer "Knight of Isliid", it was made to catch the eye rather than food, obvious to anyone who has ever handled a sizzling pan. For that reason, Priscilla dons this when presenting -- not preparing -- her handiwork.

name: Twinflame Helm "Garmroar" Replica
description: A reproduction of a legendary helmet that contains the power of the double-headed Beast Garm. Although inferior to the original, it still offers better protection than anything on the market since it was made with the creature's hide. The material's rarity combined with how it neutralizes common fire magic means it's already the stuff of epics to the average adventurer.

name: Twinflame Helm "Garmroar" Custom
description: A reproduction of a legendary helmet that contains the power of the double-headed Beast Garm. Unlike other imitations, this uses even rarer, magic-rich body parts for flame resistance on an entirely different level. All of a country's court magicians could cast their strongest fire spells and leave not a wisp of smoke. Some believe it possibly surpasses the original.

name: Iceshard Shield "Aeruscale" Replica
description: A reproduction of a frigid shield made from tempered scales of Aerugraxes. Freezing halts molecular motion. Destruction alters molecular positions. These two concepts provide the theoretical basis that a mass at absolute zero will give flawless defense. Unfortunately, this imitation is crafted with fragments which compromise its sturdiness, but the super-low temperature still ensures a remarkable effect.

name: Iceshard Shield "Aeruscale" Custom
description: A reproduction of a frigid shield made from tempered scales of Aerugraxes. If destruction is the movement of molecules, then absolute zero, at which all movement is stopped, should theoretically provide perfect defense. A team of crafters used complete scales for a barrier as close to that temperature as possible. In this way, a Dragon that once threatened to wipe out civilization helped protect it.

name: Verdant Bracers "Elpdaron" Replica
description: Reproductions of wrist guards made from the scales and claws of Elpneumas. They contain the same life force that fills natural vegetation, providing the wearer with vitality and hardiness. This ability to withstand any tribulation is invaluable on the battlefield. Though inferior to the originals, they are more than capable to nurturing the next generation of warriors.

name: Verdant Bracers "Elpdaron" Custom
description: Reproductions of wrist guards made from the scales and claws of Elpneumas. The inclusion of special seeds discovered in its body grants them immense power despite being replicas. Like tree roots burrowing through stony layers, the talons can pierce soil and rock with ease. Energy that normally cultivates life is thus diverted into strength for battle.

name: True "Braise de Bamint"
description: Coming Soon!

name: Searing Blade "Braise de Bamint"
description: Coming Soon!

name: Petal Cloth "Mirage de Bamint"
description: Coming Soon!

name: True "Happiness Trigger"
description: The unusually large syringe of the Witch of Annihilation, Aristela. She filled it with a strength-enhancing elixir so the Giants could better fight against the World-Devouring Beast. According to her, it was potent enough to kill a normal person, but a normal person could not withstand being pricked by such a large needle in the first place.

name: Paradise Needle "Happiness Trigger"
description: A syringe used by Aristela. Its size is adjustable, but she often keeps it large enough to frighten the Giant brothers for her amusement. However, whenever they enter a village, she shrinks it for storing in a pouch to avoid traumatizing children. This convinced the Giants that even she can show consideration at times.

name: Wrenchcoat "Mind Cracker"
description: The garb of magical medicine expert, Aristela. Its design more closely resembles a nurse's uniform than a sorcerer's or apothecary's robes. With a divine smile, she will easily break down the most stubborn heart. Even Giants cannot hide anything in her presence, as one will unwittingly admit after a few drinks. "If only I knew what she was up to from the start..."

name: Gleaming Crux "Fosbrace" Replica
description: Coming Soon!

name: Gleaming Crux "Fosbrace" Custom
description: Coming Soon!

name: Hades Tome "Plutorix" Replica
description: Coming Soon!

name: Hades Tome "Plutorix" Custom
description: Coming Soon!

name: True "Kubou"
description: A set of pearls owned by the Demon Kokuri that operate semi-autonomously based on her will. Their power depends on the magical energy of the user, with near limitless potential based on their strength. Despite this, they will react to the slightest weakness in one's thoughts, requiring a high degree of mastery to utilize well. Currently bound to Kokuri, no one else can draw out their power.

name: Conflagrant Pearls "Kubou"
description: A set of nine semi-autonomous pearls that draw their power from the user's thoughts and magical energy. Each is engraved with a different seal, bestowing various traits for attack, defence, binding, and more. Cut from extremely rare magical crystals, very few exist in circulation.

name: Magical Garb "Ruban le Lien"
description: Favorite outfit of the Demon girl Kokuri with a trendy design from a certain Demon nation. Using stretchy fibers that provide a great fit, and firmer fibers that hold the ribbon's shape, one can truly appreciate the level of craftsmanship. However, not much is left to the imagination, leading to criticism from elders.

name: True "Maken Zanketsu"
description: The weapon wielded by Vox in defense of Granadia. Auge's influence sparked a fearsome transformation in his blade, but the hilt remains the same. This is the result of Juno's blood keeping that dark power in check. Even after her departure, she continues to protect her beloved nation and its people.

name: Maken Zanketsu
description: Vox's blade after he obtained the Demon Lord's power. Its appearance was greatly altered, now truly befitting a merciless master of combat. The only trace of its former dignity can be seen in its hilt.

name: Netherlord Armor "Beelzedia"
description: Armor worn by Vox after becoming the Demon Lord. Despite its bulk, it is actually formed of his own magic and does not make contact with his body to weigh it down. As long as his power remains and enemies threaten Granadia, it will repel any and all attacks, giving him the name "the Indomitable Demon Lord".

name: True "Neon Bayonet"
description: Jay tinkered with his model to remove the energy limiter, greatly amplifying its output. Although the recoil would blow most people off their feet, he takes advantage of the momentum with clever agility. In his hands, it is the perfect combination of maneuverability and power.

name: Neon Bayonet
description: A weapon developed by the Machine Norn upon request of Isliid's military. It both forms sabers and fires projectiles with super-condensed optical energy. However, the advantages of mixing close- and long-range attacks come at the cost of absurd complexity. Even one with natural combat expertise like Jay has yet to draw out half of its potential.

name: Blue Jacket
description: Light armor worn by Fenrir Corps soldiers. Based on the design of Captain Roy's coat, it boasts ease of movement, durability, and trendy styling. That look also found great popularity among the public, and a number of imitations cropped up. The official serial number "ISB-E6" was even supplanted by the colloquial name "Blue Jacket".

name: Sword God's Proof
description: The pendant of Clyde, one of the Three Blades Masters of the Ancient War. It was awarded to him by the emperor of Isliid at the time, recognizing his status. He normally had little interest in trinkets of the like, but he wore it at every official function and ceremony. That may have been how he showed gratitude to Mashereed, who selected him as knight captain regardless of his commoner status.

name: Frozen Empress' Proof
description: The medal of Corsair, one of the Three Blades Masters of the Ancient War. It was awarded by to her by the princess of Bamint at the time. Due to her father's constant admonishment to give up the sword and find a spouse, she felt this provided her with long-desired justification to live as a warrior. However, an ever greater source of joy was the genuine praise from that very same father.

name: Sword Emperor's Proof
description: The earrings of Arth, one of the Three Blades Masters of the Ancient War. They were awarded to him by the Gramenian president of the time. He actually declined them at first since the old memory of a fellow Zairyudo pupil weighed on his mind. Quarrels over the nature of their purpose resulted in him abandoning the school. Arth requested a furlough to visit his hometown and settle things between them, since his pride as a swordsman told him he could not be a true master until he did.

name: Sub-Zero Soles "Chilblains"
description: Boots carved from the never-melting ice of Stiria. Lighter than standard materials such as steel, they provide superior mobility as well as superior protection. However, this comes with the ever-present threat of frostbite. It is usually mitigated by multiple layers of insulating socks, so most people choose a size two or three increments larger than the proper fit.

name: Luminous Tiara
description: The tiara of Feena, one of the Twin Knights of the Morning Star, received in recognition of her feats during the Ancient War. Blessed by a higher God, its overpowering aura repulsed minor Demons. This let it serve as both a symbol of gratitude for her devotion as a former Human and a safeguard against her aiding the enemy.

name: Ravenblack Headpiece
description: The helmet of Regulus, one of the Twin Knights of the Morning Star, and standard issue for the Raven's Aegis during the Ancient War. As their mission was to defend the sorcerers, his refusal to carry a shield was akin to heresy. However, his prowess with the blade saved his allies on many occasions, earning their trust enough for them to return the favor. Even after they disbanded with the war's end, he continued to wear this as a keepsake of their bonds.

name: True "Millennium Arc"
description: Coming soon!

name: Aged Crystal "Millennium Arc"
description: Coming soon!

name: Ribnald Beret
description: Coming soon!

name: Spirit Steps "Element Rows"
description: Coming soon!

name: Mira's Essential Purifier
description: A bikini Mira secretly prepared for the trip to a beach famous for its picturesque sunsets. Borrowing design trends from Bamint's traditional priestess garb, her bravado to wear such a pared-down look wowed Rayas and the others. Whether or not it had the same evil-warding effect was entirely unrelated to rumors of recent phantom sightings at their destination. Someone as smart and strong and skilled and sexy as her would never be afraid of ghosts.

name: Kane's Independence Day
description: Trunks worn by Kane for the express purpose of enjoying his vacation. Since becoming president, he was rarely allowed to go anywhere without heavy security detail. He imagined while standing on the coastline wearing nothing but these how his bodyguards would likely faint dead away to see him so vulnerable. Regardless, he was ready to free both body and spirit in a brief return to civilian life.

name: Serah's Outdoor Attendant
description: A swimsuit with a chic design Serah selected for this summer. The hidden pockets and black-and-white coloring suited her occupation...until she remembered that she was originally a research assistant rather than a servant. She decided to put aside her usual habits and have fun on the beach...then started preparing for the BBQ.

name: Marika's Mari-Style Mariner
description: A one-piece swimsuit Serah chose for Marika. The scarlet color scheme matches her hair, and the design, used in far-east festivities, draws out her simple appeal. Marika always knew Serah had an eye for fashion, but this particular selection made her think she also liked wordplay.

name: Lotte's Friendship Frills
description: A swimsuit Zeorg bought for his beloved granddaughter. The wide frills around the shoulders brings to mind a ballerina's outfit. He actually got one in the same design with a different color which completely slipped his mind. Charlotte thought to give that to Valerie since it would go unused otherwise. In contrast to her nonchalant attitude, her friend's eyes were wider than the plates at their favorite buffet.

name: Valerie's Friendship Frills
description: A swimsuit that Charlotte gave to Valerie after her grandfather accidentally bought another one in a different color. When inside the beach changing room, she could be overheard muttering: "I'm only wearing it to make Lotte happy, not because I think it looks cute or anything like that." Yet despite the stern expression, she gave a slight but unmistakable smile.

name: Iris' Dream Rocket
description: A jumbo-sized firework packed with vivid colors. Iris specially ordered it to spread a sparkling garden across summer's clear night sky. Like other fireworks, it was not meant to shoot at living things; Rolly simply knocked it in the general direction of Rayas by accident. Always remember to handle real fireworks with care.

name: Fen's Wavecutter
description: A specially made longboard for Fen. Careful upkeep has staved off wear and tear over the years, allowing for tight turns like no other. His boasts that it lets him overcome any wave are backed up by his total trust in it. Along with Ru as a lure, he needs nothing else to enjoy the summer season.

name: Celestial Vessel "Zexraster" Replica
description: A reproduction of Marzex's necklace, the source of his healing power. Although inferior to the original, it was made with ore imbued with his residual energy from the site of advent to suitably mimic that effect. It also operates in the same way as his heart of compassion, showing the greatest blessing to the gentle, the benevolent, and the burdened.

name: Celestial Vessel "Zexraster" Custom
description: A reproduction of Marzex's necklace, the source of his healing power. This particular one contains even more material bathed in the God's aura. This both brings it closer in line to the original's strength and casts a barrier around the holder. As such, it can be said to be the physical manifestation of his protective embrace.

name: Kilmon Sword
description: A weapon carried by the attackers of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. Strong by nature, Kilmons become even more powerful in the presence of Tufmons and Defmons. Among Spirits, the phrase "Tasmon sword" extols the benefit of fighting in a group rather than by oneself. Yet as Defmons carry shields and Tufmons carry scepters, there is no question that it is a direct reference to Kilmons, those that engage in actual combat.

name: Defmon Shield
description: A shield carried by the defenders of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. Sturdy by nature, Defmons become even more resilient in the presence of Kilmons and Tufmons. They wanted to be the focus of a popular phrase like the other two and attempted coining "Tasmon shield" to describe the phenomenon of stability in numbers. However, since it heavily cribbed from an existing idiom, it failed to gain much traction.

name: Tufmon Rod
description: A scepter carried by the tacticians of the Spirit attack squad Tristan. Clever by nature, Tufmons become even more intelligent in the presence of Kilmons and Defmons. There is a saying among Spirits claiming "Three Tasmons can rival the Ten Divine Forces." It means that it is possible to outwit even the Gods by pooling thoughts together instead of worrying alone. Tufmons are so thrilled by the recognition that they completely disregard its sarcastic undertone.

name: Glacial Soles "Frostpain"
description: Boots crafted from the never-melting ice of Stiria. Through endothermic reactions, they absorb almost all heat for perpetuity. This lets them maintain solidity in the hottest environments. The wearer can even walk through a river of lava comfortably, provided it is no deeper than the boots' height.

name: Riviera's Keelhaul Coat
description: The overcoat of Captain Riviera. Despite its bulk, the coloring matches her bathing suit and the tough look matches her personality. Although some of her crew found the styling a touch too ostentatious, none were boorish enough to mention it. The ability to switch from mature to childish at the drop of a hat was yet another part of her charm.

name: Rosetta's Inner Guard
description: A outfit developed to be worn beneath energized armor. The tight fit ensures fabric does not get caught in the machinery, meaning any resemblance to a swimsuit is purely coincidental. Although fairly exact specifications of her physical proportions were needed, the researchers hesitated to ask. They ended up making two variants, and the smaller one was accepted.

name: Rosetta's Ultimate Frame
description: Energized armor for Rosetta. It receives power remotely from the Great Granadia, allowing it to operate indefinitely while within range. However, the internal storage capacity is low, so it only takes a few minutes before becoming an unconventional metal cage. Should she get carried away and leave the ship's energy field, it is inevitably up to Berwick to retrieve her from the seafloor.

name: Leone's Green Charmer
description: A swimsuit for Leone in a pretty green hue. As much as she enjoyed previous beach outings, she felt uncomfortably out of place. This year would be different -- she had made plans with Rosetta to wear matching outfits. However, her friend's choice ended up being a little on the cumbersome side, so she decided to instead go with a color matching the shade of her hair for a more sentimental pairing.

name: Leone's Angelic Sandals
description: Beach footwear for Leone. She slept with them in her arms the night before leaving on vacation, dreaming about strolling across the sandy shores. They fell behind her bed while she slept and were forgotten until arriving at the tropical resort. The fine sand made walking barefoot easy enough, but she felt sorry for her carelessness denying them a chance to shine. In her heart, she promised they would come along next year.

name: Riviera's Rancor Anchor
description: The anchor of her ship, the Granadia, repurposed as a weapon. Although it took several men to raise something of this size, she swung it around with ease like one of her usual battleaxes. "She knows how to handle big, dense things," her shield-bearing colleague remarked while giving a strangely pleasant grin. Having been acquainted with her for years, his tone carried resigned confidence.

name: Riviera's Powder Keg
description: Loosely pirate-themed swimwear belonging to Riviera. It was surprisingly chosen by Thetis, although not as a display of thoughtfulness like a surprise gift. Rather, she narrowed down the options to two and gave him the final call. He shut his eyes and pointed randomly at this bombastic burgundy bikini, a perfect fit for someone explosive in several meanings.

name: Great Granadia
description: A high-tech aerial warship developed by Rosetta. Its speed outclassed every other craft in the Pirate Kingdom. Although many questioned if entering a flying vessel in a nautical competition was fair, she argued there was no rule forbidding it. When it dominated the competition, her response to those grousing that it should have been banned was, "Why not make all the ships fly?" Her gaze was ever fixed on the future, as demonstrated by her next goal to develop a time-travel system.

name: True "Ces' Sandy Blossom"
description: A swimsuit with a tropical flower motif. She was afraid to wear it last year due to how it left little to the imagination, but the only other people on the private beach were her siblings. Realizing it would be a waste to not enjoy the vacation, she cheerfully cast aside worry and frolicked in the waves. Her mind, free from the concern of prying eyes, could indulge in the skin-caressing breeze...and the habit-forming liberation.

name: True "Liza's Mature Look"
description: Her ever-reliable swimsuit. Luahn innocently said how jealous he was of her never needing to shop for a new one. After delivering a drop kick to the back of his head, she reconsidered why insinuations of being "small" offended her so much. Petite figures were few and far between, a charming distinction to be carried with pride. Even so, she was frustrated at being unable to land a drop kick on the back of Orvell's head, who was still laughing.

name: True "Shadow Cutter"
description: Canaria's lack of expertise caused the edge of this dagger to chip and break. After numerous repairs, sharpness was replaced with durability to make it a dependable ally that takes advantage of her speed. Swift blows can dent steel armor, and flashes of its past cutting ability emerge on fluky occasions.

name: Shadow Cutter
description: A dagger with an edge supposedly sharp enough to slice through shadows. It does not work as advertised, but the blade was honed to its limit. This also left it with a complete lack of toughness. A novice would soon chip and break it, yet an expert can rend steel like cloth. Canaria, presently, is the former.

name: Canaria's Blue Jacket
description: A Fenrir Corps outfit for women, customized with her favorite muffler. Unlike the men's version, it is lighter and simpler in design. This came as a great disappointment to her when she first received it since she hoped to match with Jay. The other members still rib her for that rare display of immaturity.

name: Golcat King Crown
description: Golcats will resort to all kinds of trickery to steal from adventurers. This is because obsession with money is a point of pride in their eyes. For this reason, a firm backbone is required in making deals with them. Any offer they feel is unfavorable will be flatly refused, but they pounce at every chance to bilk even one more Gren. "Golcat's got your tongue," is a phrase commonly used to criticize someone driving an unfair trade.

name: Metal Chicken Tiara
description: Metal Chickens aspire to learn everything about the world. They travel from country to country, accumulating information in their sturdy bodies. As their stores of knowledge grow, so does their size and weight. Although this causes them to move ever more ponderously, they flap their wings all the same. "Curiosity makes the Metal Chicken fly," is a common adage describing those who ardently work for their goals no matter how heavy their burdens.

name: True "Shangri-La"
description: A shining blade held by the ultimate ruler, Celia. Having fed upon her ghostly servants, its attacks are greatly strengthened. She can compel them to become sacrifices using her Ancient blood's power, but they do so of their own will. Either it indeed leads the lost to paradise, or they are inspired by her ceaseless efforts to forge an ideal world -- the truth is only known to them.

name: Skybound Sword "Shangri-La"
description: The treasured weapon wielded by the first princess of Bamint, Celia. Like Grand Scale, it was sealed away underneath the castle. The Ancient script engraved on the blade says, "Rest in peace", letting it become stronger by converting souls into magic. Bamint traditional belief claims the dead move on to a paradise at the edge of the world. This cuts their lingering attachments and guides them there.

name: Jeweled Finery "Emerodite"
description: Armor worn by the first princess of Bamint, Celia. The shining emeralds give it an elegant air that suits one of her regality. Each gemstone is engraved with advanced defensive symbols from old Bamint, reflecting all attacks when fitted around a bearer of royal blood.

name: Lotte's Fluffy Mitts
description: Cute wolf-like gloves begging to be ruffled. Constant requests to pet them annoyed her enough, but it was people who did so without permission that crossed the line. To teach them a lesson, she replaced the most inviting spots of fur with hedgehog spikes.

name: Lotte's Clawed Paws
description: Long boots modeled after a wolf's legs. Shock-absorbent cushions under the sole in the shape of squishy paw pads allow for sneaking, and the spikes along the toes produce rather painful impacts. However, she was unsettled by the number of people who pleaded to be stomped or kicked.

name: Valerie's Lizalee Staff
description: A handmade staff modeled after Lizalee's. Accurate to the fine details, any fan of the series would give up an arm and a leg for it. Charlotte, after learning it was in fact not official merchandise, was awestruck anew by her friend's obsessi-- enthusiasm.

name: Trick the Trickster
description: Tricklock, a royal magician from long ago, sealed his soul inside of this lantern after death. On Halloween nights, he will emerge to play potentially pernicious pranks. Regardless, he is friendly and hard to dislike, and his curses leave smiles on the faces of everyone involved once they are dispelled.

name: Forte's Dolly Dress
description: A jet-black dress apparently included with Trick's curse. It was not chosen to suit the tastes of anyone in particular; she simply needed to wear something that fit her smaller body. Although it disappeared along with the spell, its elegance stuck in the mind of a local tailor, who recreated the design while the memory was still fresh.

name: Forte's Funny Hat
description: An incredibly adorable hat. That fact that it is far too small to serve its intended purpose simply adds charm. Combined with her frilly dress, it creates an angel of flawless ebony brilliance. Many who saw her became style-obsessed, making it a cursed item in a sense.

name: Jack-O-Sherum Plushie EV
description: Modeled after the pumpkin-headed monster that roams around threatening tricks if it does not receive treats. One merchant saw a comical charm in his top-heavy appearance and fashioned these dolls. Since he appears only at harvest time, he has already become a symbol of the season, and he will undoubtedly appear during Reigrad's festival this year too.
drop_information:
Exploring "Lanterns to Light the World"
[Despair], [SPEX Hyper], [Limited EX]

name: True "Rune Sovereign"
description: Wielded by Emperor Isliid, capable of cutting through matter, space, time, events, and consequence. The Crests engraved into its blade read "Build a righteous path" in Ancient language. He said he would use it to open the Fourth Door which leads to the World Tree. His goals are still unknown, but the fact it heeds him proves they have some merit.

name: True "Komplettes Trio"
description: Sky Light, made by the Gods, Terra Master, made by the Humans, and Dark Bringer, made by the Demons. Each weapon was specialized in killing the race that crafted them, adding the weight of karma. He took advantage of that as well in order to carry out his grand purpose which turned every living creature into an enemy.

name: Komplettes Trio Replica
description: The three Imperial Blades of Emperor Isliid. Only Terra Master originally belonged to Humans; Sky Light and Dark Bringer were stolen from the Gods and Demons respectively. This caused the Ancients who created them all to derisively call him the Usurper. That derision turned into hatred when he stole a treasure of their own, Nirshanal's Orb.

name: Rune Sovereign Replica
description: Although presumed to be the oldest of the Ancients' Crest Blades, no specific mention of that could be found in their records. They were powerful enough to destroy matter effortlessly, but it possesses sheer cutting ability unseen among their other artifacts. Its very existence, to say nothing of its purpose, is yet steeped in mystery.

name: True "Radical Edge"
description: Greatsword of the transforming Demon Pola. Its weight and power grows with the strength of her emotions. She believes that feature is inherent to the weapon, but it is actually a manifestation of her own ability. Altering reality via thought is considered more akin to psychic powers than magic. This is one of several reasons why she is treated differently even among the Great Six Witches.

name: Radical Edge
description: The greatsword of the cutest, strongest Demon swordswoman Pola. Its weight is tied to the weight of her emotion, and every strike deals huge damage. She becomes frustrated when enemies dodge it since she assumes her thoughts are not getting through, thus making it even heavier. Survival hinges upon carefully measuring the risk of when to accept her feelings.

name: Center of Attention
description: The dress of Demon swordswoman Pola. She always thoroughly checks herself in the mirror after putting it on. The self-made design, created with much research, hides the seams for a flawless look from every angle. Although her transformation magic should preclude the need to go to such lengths, she feels that handmade clothes bring out the greatest feminine charm.

name: Nano Barrier "Zweitschild"
description: A Nanoarc shield attached to Zwiber Z. Consuming magic energy lets it alter hardness and shape to repel impacts of any nature. However, that functionality is lost without a power supply, and it has poor fuel efficiency. Such drawbacks did not hinder Zwiber Z by design, but adventurers found trouble in repurposing it.

name: True "Gladius"
description: Carried by Roy along with the Sainted Garb. Symbol of honor in the knighthood, it was ironically granted to him by his assassination target, Emperor Isliid. Roy added the ability to shoot projectiles for that exact purpose. Even after the depth of the emperor's deeds came to light and justified his crime, the fact he used the same method as infamous traitor Hart led many to call him "the Apostate Paladin".

name: Sainted Sword "Gladius"
description: The weapon used by Roy of the Isliid knights. Originally a ritual piece, the sanctification process performed by the emperor imbued it with great magic and the unique imperial property of isolation. This clear divide of the outside from its interior grants a supremely keen edge. In fact, it is superior to all but Rune Sovereign in terms of sheer strength among the national treasures.

name: Sainted Armor "Aeolus"
description: The core of the Sainted Garb worn by Roy. Like Gladius, it contains the magic of the imperial bloodline and its unique isolating properties. That nullifies over 99% of dark energy, letting him carry the Phantom Bullets without falling victim to their soul-warping effect.

name: Garland Sword "Star Light"
description: One of the Imperial Blades personally decorated by Emperor Isliid for the Christmas festival at the temple. The slogan for this year's event was "Smiles for the people", yet among the reverent congregation, only Noel cracked a grin at the usually majestic sword wreathed in frippery. He hastily apologized for his disrespect, but the emperor gave his own satisfied smile. "I suppose we can call this a success."

name: Resolute Reindeer Noel
description: A doll that he created himself for Christmas. Using leftover material after finishing Emperor Isliid's, this one unintentionally turned out better. That could not stand even if it was simply the benefit of experience. Challenging himself, he swore to make the next doll for the emperor even more perfect.

name: Perfect Santa Emperor
description: A doll made by Noel as a gift for the Christmas festival. It is designed after the otherworld saint Santa Claus, known for spreading joy and cheer to all, and Noel believed there was no one in this world more deserving. Although he knew he could not completely repay his liege for all he had been given, he hoped the show of appreciation would bring a smile to that honorable face.

name: Loving Snow Princess
description: A doll Mira made for Bamint's royal Christmas party. She still envies her older sister -- how her hair remains like silk even during battle, how her eyes are so piercingly blue, how her smile is warm like the sun...and how she does not let herself be weighed down by such shameful feelings. All of that was poured into Mira's handiwork, enhancing its charm.

name: Hunting Santa Jay
description: A doll made by Canaria for the Fenrir Corps' Christmas party. It was meant to be a decoration for the party venue instead of a present. She also made versions of the other Corps members, so this is in no way, shape, or form a present for that spoony jerk. As a result, she did not expect a word of thanks from him...but skipping the party to cavort in town was an unforgivable infraction. Her fist of justice struck this effigy square in the face.

name: Watchful Reindeer Canaria
description: A doll she made for the Christmas party. She also created one based on every member of the Fenrir Corps as decorations. Despite the careful consideration she put in their arrangement, someone moved hers next to Jay's, her partner, during the night. She wanted to put it back, but that seemed like it would arouse suspicions in her mind. Overtaken by uncertainty, she irrationally punched the effigy of her partner square in the face.

name: Mad Scythe
description: A massive sickle with Saint Groitz's aesthetic sensibilities, reflecting his noble Ancient lineage. It emerges from the coccyx during Revelation. Having absorbed Ego Lu Ville of the Ten Divine Forces, he wields that God's power of judgment. Therefore, would it not be appropriate to call him judge of the modern age? Each strike, laden with justice, landing on the crown of the head probably causes quite a bit of pain. It hurts, doesn't it? Say it hurts!

name: Exclusion Barrier "Azulveidt"
description: A Nanoarc shield attached by Zwiber Ω. The shape and nature are adjustable with magic. Although boasting superior heat, shock, and biohazard resistance, it can only handle one of these threats at a time. Defensive shifts also happen according to its own artificial intelligence, spending power against the user's wishes. Research into the Ancients' Nanoarc technology has hardly begun, so details about its workings are unclear.

name: True "Vespada"
description: A musket developed to amplify the senses for flawless accuracy. Whoever holds this can detect hidden enemies and perforate them where they lurk. For all its benefits, protracted battles are dangerous due to the mental burden of maintaining that spell. Merlette, with grace, intelligence, pride, willpower, and elegance, can do so for nearly five times the average timespan.

name: Flashing Barrel "Vespada"
description: A musket once used by Merlette's father. It has an enchantment that heightens all five of the holder's senses to their limits. While granting perfect accuracy on visible targets, activating the spell itself demands great concentration. This means not even she has fully mastered it, as shown by an imperfect success rate.

name: Splendid Garment "Vestito Blu"
description: The standard issue outfit of the Fenrir Corps drastically modified by Merlette. Although Canaria doubts it falls within regulations, the superb design and prime Gramenian silk reflects the dignity of an imperial knight. This came at the cost of five months' salary, but she does not mind if it gets too dirty or damaged; there are another nine of equal quality in reserve.

name: True "Asgard's Casket"
description: Designated a super-first class artifact of Old Bamint magic, the Ancients created it to store mana. Its noteworthy capacity can purportedly power a freighter for an entire year. However, this is an estimate formed by knowledge gleaned from historic records, as current technology lacks the ability to utilize it to that extent. Hart took it from Azvan's room for a specific purpose.

name: Asgard's Casket
description: An unassuming necklace with a simple design. It was believed to provide no benefit to its wearer, only absorbing any mana provided until Hart recognized the pattern from the archives. This led him to discover it was an apparatus of Old Bamint magic created by the Ancients. It can store energy in perpetuity without leakage or decay -- an all-purpose battery.

name: Ritual Greaves "Blenfate"
description: Battle footgear Hart received from Azvan. His repeated use of speed-boosting magic wore away the soles in less than a month, so he combined physical hardening with friction-increasing spells to add both durability and traction. He applied the same improvements to Emi's shoes, although it was to prevent tripping due to her unrefined gait rather than quick movements.

name: Magnid's Blade
description: The weapon that gained the Fire Dragon deity's might after stabbing its heart. That perpetually fervid edge can reduce anything to ash. A great hero once wielded it against a entire army at the cost of his own life. The fearsome display was seared into the minds of all who witnessed it, and the battleground became known as the Hill of Hell.

name: Ul-Megea's Earrings
description: Grants the blessing of the Water Dragon deity. Previously worn by a mermaid, it was bought by a rich mogul at an auction for a high price under the assumption it was simply a beautiful piece of jewelry. That changed when the town where he lived was struck by a huge flood, starting a rumor that it was cursed by the original owner. It stood to reason since said auction was illegal by nature, dealing in dangerous articles forbidden from sale.

name: Romria's Shield
description: Harnesses the Earth Dragon's power to freely manipulate nature. The holder is granted the fury of a gale and the stoutness of a tree, but their soul withers in return. Most eventually end up as invalids, and the only way to stave off such a fate is to be firm in both heart and body from the start.

name: Silk Loving Broom "Etoile V"
description: Liza's favorite broom transformed by the Shiny Sphere's power. The mint-green ribbon is reminiscent of a perfectly wrapped candy box. It has the baffling ability to produce sweets from the handle when charged with mana, a dream come true for any sugar junkie. However, as it manifested from Liza's mind, their quality is equivalent to whatever she imagines.

name: Arc's Lance
description: A spear that symbolizes a hero of valor. Long ago, a Human warrior dared to challenge the light Dragon deity. When all hope seemed lost, he turned the tables in a desperate attempt and returned with the broken horn as proof of his feat. It was then honed sharp enough to pierce even scales. This weapon's holder is also blessed with a chance at victory no matter how dire the situation, worthy for any spirit that does not quail in the face of distress or adversity.

name: Vajara's Axe
description: An axe that symbolizes a lord of villainy. Hewn from a dark Dragon deity's scale, it spills a never-ending stream of miasma. Any living thing it grazes will be seized by panic, leaving them defenseless. This powerful effect comes at the cost of gradually eroding the holder's heart. Unless they are as diabolic and ruthless as a despot, they will not retain their sanity.

name: True "Zanjinjoka"
description: Lark's katana transformed after feeding on vast amounts of blood. While a normal sword would become rusted and unusable, the oil in the blood let its flames burn hotter and deadlier in addition to preserving its edge. This weapon, created for Entei-Ryu, was brought to completion by his tenacity.

name: Red Swallow "Zanjinjoka"
description: A long katana handed down to the master of Entei-Ryu. Its characteristic crimson makes the blur from each swing look like a burning flame. Long ago, an otherworld blacksmith who was enchanted by this school of swordplay used ore from his homeland he happened to bring with him to craft it.

name: Firmament Guards "Alveda"
description: Bracers partially made from the somatic cells of Marzex. The wearer will obtain his merciful healing power. No one understands the actual workings behind their restorative properties, but researchers have managed to cultivate his cells from them to conduct further study. It may very well become possible for sinners who do not fear the Gods' judgment to nonetheless receive their grace.

name: True "Festivilion"
description: The magical scepter of the Witch of Peace, Elenore, when its true abilities are unleashed. The antique design of its machinery hides a mana control function. Normally, it amplifies or converts its user's power, but by rotating the secret third hand, it can also *REDACTED* space-time itself.

name: Time Staff "Festivilion"
description: The magic scepter of Elenore, Witch of Peace from the "Six Witches of Grimm Stella". The top is an old clockwork contraption, belying its magical power. It was said her students were reminded of its simple chime whenever they heard a clock tower's bells. She always wore an expression of deep fondness while winding it.

name: True "Rising Nova"
description: An anti-Stardeity weapon Emi gave to Valerie on a whim. It can assume the shape most suitable for its user -- merely the tip of its unfathomable capabilities. Humans like her can only unlock enough of that potential to fight standard opponents, but while she is in Overflow mode, it can destroy far larger targets.

name: Starsword "Rising Nova"
description: A weapon that reads the biological information of its user and changes shape to suit them. In Valerie's hands, it turned into a sword as a result of the Hero of Famelle's tutoring. Emi, an Ancient who settled into Reigrad, gave it to her without mentioning its original purpose of fighting Stardeities. It will bring out its true power upon mastery, but as far as Valerie is presently concerned, it is only an "extremely sharp sword".

name: True "Deep Blood"
description: The weapon of the Demon intent on taking back the Moonchild. Made of blood, it has the ability to transform at will. Besides the length of the blade posing a threat, it can sling small projectiles. He also uses it as the origin point of his Realm of Red in which he holds complete control. Entering it ensures death as the victim's vision is filled with blood, both that of his blades and their own.

name: Sanguine Scythe "Deep Blood"
description: The weapon of the Demon who attacked Rayas' party. Ultra-condensed blood is fashioned into a blade of fearsome sharpness. It can also be instantly reformed should it break. One must never let down their guard against him, particularly since he can create another edge at any time.

name: True "Twin Falcons"
description: A cutlass-and-pistol pairing owned by Azel. As adherent to the creed of "the best defense is a good offense" (in his words, "only idiots get hit"), he opted for weapons of pure aggression, covering close and long ranges. These specific models are relatively common, but he proves that sufficient talent can work with tools of any quality.

name: Hypertrophy Guards "Zexveda"
description: Bracers made from the cells of Marzex after he was defeated by a heroic warrior. Their incredible healing abilities prompted trials as all-purpose military gear, but a problem soon presented itself: they would bond to the skin if worn for too long. Although this demonstrated their power is based on promoting cell regeneration, the underlying principles are still unclear. That is the researchers' greatest concern at present.

name: True "Duo Ritual"
description: The blade of the God swordsman Luahn, the might of the Ama-no-Yuraragi's spirit living in him made manifest. It heavily favors sharpness over resilience. The extremely thin metal is vulnerable to strikes from the side and demands exact accuracy from its holder. Having gained mastery in the Gran Verge school from his father and his brother, he can wield it without difficulty.

name: Dragon Katana "Duo Ritual"
description: The weapon held by the God swordsman, Luahn. A physical manifestation of the Dragon Ama-no-Yuraragi's power, its extreme sharpness is comparable to Sky Light's. Although this leaves it with low durability, the Dragon's spirit residing in Luahn can instantly regenerate wear and tear along the edge, but not without a stream of complaints regarding "ungraceful swordsmanship".

name: Dragon Robe "Merciful Majesty"
description: Battle garb of the God swordsman Luahn. Like his weapon, it is formed by the power of Ama-no-Yuraragi spirit's living inside of him. It offers little in the way of defense, and its billowing fabric does not allow for quick movements. Instead, the Dragon, seeking elegance even in combat, created every last detail to turn the wearer into a spectacle, including the enhancement of their physical capabilities.

name: True "Mira's Fishy Skewer"
description: A spear transformed by the treasure of the merfolk into a supremely powerful trident. Although originally meant for recreation, it gained the sea deity's power over currents. It also forms a layer of air around the holder to permit underwater breathing. She relished in the mermaid-like experience, cavorting through the seas, but soon remembered her lungs still had Human limitations.

name: True "Celia's Paraíso Parasol"
description: An umbrella with extra UV blocking by her demand. Sunlight is the archenemy of a fair complexion, but she places absolute faith in this defensive shade, calling it the "sacred protection field". However, some of her servants are concerned its complete coverage precludes the need for applying suntan lotion.

name: Mira's Fishy Skewer
description: The harpoon she purchased on the Beasts' island to catch fish. She painted the handle to add an eye-catching gradation, but it caught the eyes of potential prey as well, driving them away. She then switched to a regular rod and reel out of disappointment and found instant success.

name: Mira's Critical Crystal
description: A light blue bikini with a frilly skirt as sparky as the southern seas. Its design balances adult allure and youthful charm. She bought it from a shop then added a ribbon to the top and the belt to the bottom. Her intent was to give a touch of coolness for a thorough representation of herself, but everyone's impression was more "hot".

name: Mira's Romantic Outlook
description: Unsparingly cute sunglasses with heart-shaped frames and pink-tinted lenses that never fail to draw attention. Although they can come off as awkward on the wrong person, they bring out her adorable side despite her tough demeanor. That being said, their unusual shape and color make normal use awkward, so she leaves them on her head.

name: Celia's Paraíso Parasol
description: A sun umbrella wide enough to cover even her imposing stature. She naturally prepared it for protection from the sun, but she had a blacksmith modify it for self-defense as well, giving it a solid steel shaft to drive into enemies. Although she expected this vacation to be full of contingences, it was touch-and-go from the moment she landed on the island. As a result, her acquaintances only saw it as a weapon.

name: Servants' Select
description: A luxurious dark purple swimsuit received from a boutique with ties to the royal family. Her servants examined each option before deciding on it. The unique design, the lace around the top, and the golden embroidery required days of work from Bamint's finest tailor. The sight of her wearing this, the veil flapping around her curvaceous figure, did not just sway the hearts of her servants but anyone who witnessed it.

name: Celia's Cultured Eyewear
description: Glasses with photochromatic lenses for adjustable UV protection. They darken like sunglasses under outdoor light but return to full clarity in shelter. Although she looks stylish when wearing them either normally or atop her head, there is a fierce debate among her servants as to which placement suits her best.

name: True "Iris' Dream Rocket"
description: An explosive in the shape of a missile. Iris wanted something that would blossom brilliantly among the stars, giving her friends a spectacle to vividly remember for the rest of their lives. Answering her request, the pyrotechnician filled this with extra magic (gunpowder). The finished product made not just flowers bloom in the sky but smiles bloom on the ground.

name: True "Fen's Wavecutter"
description: The surfboard Fen uses to shoot the curl on his rare getaways. His picture-perfect form is comprised of three pieces. First is his technique that neither fights nor surrenders to the flow. Second is his long-time companion that acts like an extension of his body. Last but not least is his patience that lets him wait until the biggest wave of the year arrives...all while the furry self-proclaimed fourth piece clings tight.

name: True "Rosetta's Inner Guard"
description: The interior part of her Rosetta Arm. Since the researches could only take visual estimate of her measurements, they created two sizes. The smaller one was a near-exact fit, but she insisted to hold the other in reserve "to account for future developments". The researchers silently relented, hoping her expectations were misplaced.

name: True "Riviera's Powder Keg"
description: The swimsuit Riviera wears as a pirate captain. Its design fully employs her generous proportions, but the scant coverage does not give much protection. Regardless, she wore it in the thick of every cannonball-laden naval battle. Most of her crew, including her shield-bearing first mate and defensive expert, wondered why she did not choose something with anti-ballistic properties, yet they felt unable to speak their mind.

name: True "Ceed Ix Flamma"
description: "My name is Eska Chroma the Sentient Blade, a weapon forged for the Ancient hero Prometheus to slay the Tellurian Deity. My shape and function change according to the will of my holder for optimal performance. Only those who carry the genes of Prometheus can wield my power. To anyone else, I am no more than an iron lump."

name: Inner Spark "Ceed Ix Flamma"
description: The original form of Exceed Zechs after shedding its evil appearance in response to Charlotte's will. A furious blaze courses through the metal and leaps out with each swing. However, this deadly effect requires being held by a True Master, meaning her. It also consumes a great amount of mana in a short time, demanding focus to prevent overexertion even with her ample reserves.

name: True "Lotte's Fluffy Mitts"
description: Wolf-like gloves Charlotte wore on Halloween night. She became so caught up in the excitement of the holiday that she even spoke in nothing but barks and howls. However, this started to get on her friend's nerves. "You're starting to get on my nerves." This direct remark finally elicited something else from her mouth: a mournful whine.

name: True "Magical Muscles Valerie"
description: A witch-like outfit Valerie wore on Halloween night. The girly frills and ribbon clashed with her cool attitude in a positive way. Despite insisting up and down that she looked awkward in it, her friend's deluge of compliments was enough to convince her of the very slight possibility she might be a tiny bit cute. The reality of her profound charm was yet unimaginable.

name: True "Forte's Dolly Dress"
description: The ink-black dress Forte wore on Halloween night. Its intricate design gave this pint-sized commander the appearance of an actual doll. She owns clothes of a similar fashion, so it was not the look itself that she found objectionable rather than how Charlotte and Valerie fawned over everything she did. She seemingly disliked being treated as a child...except for the hoard of free candy she received.

name: True "Traumerei"
description: The weapon held by the Divine Knight commander Platina. Also known as the Dream Eater, it consumes the memories of its wielder. Continued use causes them to forget more and more of their past. She has yet to show any significant change, yet that remains to be seen if this is because of her staunch will resisting its effects or if they are still in their initial stages.

name: Ethereal Edge "Traumerei"
description: The sacred sword of Divine Knight leader Platina, granted to her by Uther. Crafted from high-purity Prima Ether, it contains the memories and thoughts of its previous holders. She draws upon that battle experience, applying it to her own technique. Whoever clashes against her may feel as if they are fighting several warriors at the same time.

name: Echoing Dress "Campanella"
description: Blessed armor supplied to the leader of the Divine Knights. It has high magic defense since the main function is protecting against Demon attacks. Being the first female commander, this was custom-made for her body. Aesthetic additions like the apron-like cloth give it a beauty not seen in the male version. Naturally, she was too stoic for such demands; they came from her closest comrade, the shield-carrying Human, who wished for her to look breathtaking on the battlefield.

name: True "Lightning Mare III"
description: The huge bludgeon of the Rabbit Squad's vice-captain. The construction ship Arceos manufactured it based on her specified design along with the large reserve supply in its storeroom. Whenever one breaks, a gate is immediately opened to provide her with a replacement. It has undergone a number of upgrades over time, and this is the third iteration.

name: Sparkmace "Lightning Mare III"
description: A ponderous battle club carried by Spirit soldier Natasha. The violet gem inside the head aids and enhances her spatial manipulation abilities along with releasing gravity waves to pull enemies after being thrown. The weapon's name comes from the burst of purple-tinged electricity when she activates that ability.

name: True "Cross of Gran Verge"
description: The paired swords of King Gran Verge. Grand Destin's power of light contains the wills of previous monarchs to bestow inexhaustible determination. Gramlude's power of shade changes anger into strength to overcome the greatest adversities. As both their weights and natures are mirror opposites, simultaneous wielders were rare in the country's history. Thus, Orvell may be the greatest warrior-lord Gran Verge has ever seen.

name: Kingdom Duo "Cross of Gran Verge"
description: Grand Destin and Gramlude wielded by Orvell. Both made of pure Prima Ether, they respond to the holder's will to create miracles. Long ago, the Ancients bestowed arms to their protectors, the Twelve Knights. Gran Verge of the Light received Grand Destin, and Zainzald of the Dark Flame took Gramlude. Gran Verge would later establish a kingdom bearing his name, meaning he is Orvell's forebear.

name: Shining Royalty "Alphadyne"
description: The garb of Gran Verge of the Light, a member of the Twelve Knights who protected the Ancients. Its brilliance drives away evil, preventing lesser monsters from approaching the wearer. Although most of the Knights' equipment was provided by the Ancients, he secretly asked a God blacksmith to craft this. Clues to his reasoning can be found in the history between the Ancients and his kingdom.

name: True "Multiple"
description: A unique spear-like weapon wielded by the audacious transfer student Menas. It slices, dices, pierces, shatters, burns, and melts, hence its "all-purpose" label. With such versatility, digging to the other side of the world is possible in theory. Curiously, the fragmentary data inside of Yuzukichi's memory bank claims its purpose is to build rather than destroy.

name: All-Purpose Blade "Multiple"
description: The polearm-shaped weapon used by the amnesiac girl Menas. Essentially a spear, it is stored inside of her support mecha Yuzukichi until necessary. How this is possible despite the obvious size discrepancy is unclear. Yuzukichi claims it has legendary status but provides no details to elucidate. Regardless, the edge is keen enough to easily slice boulders.

name: Ordinary Reindeer Firyl
description: A stuffed doll crafted by Venna. When Firyl asked about the reindeer theming, she explained the animal's sharp antlers suited his no-nonsense nature, along with it representing her wish for him to acquire the same iron will that let it survive the inhospitable tundra. Naturally, that was an off-the-cuff answer to hide the true meaning: "We're gonna work you so hard, you'll be begging to pull sleighs, newbie."

name: Wild Santa Azel
description: A stuffed doll crafted by Venna. Although resembling a legendary philanthropist from another world, Azel thought reindeer looked cooler. However, she always saw him as having the same generosity. It was something she would never put in words, but she was forever grateful he welcomed her aboard his ship.

name: Fluffy Santa Venna
description: A stuffed doll crafted by Venna. "Why'd you make yourself so cute? It looks too weird without that feral side of yours." She would take mercy on Azel's unsparing criticism at her self-rendering as the kind-hearted patron of another world and clobber him using a piece of lumber without a nail driven through the end. Amid Firyl's awkward attempts to stop her and Yuna and Claire's hearty laughter, they would spend the festive night with the usual jollity.

name: Santa Bunny Luana
description: A festive version of her bunny suit devised in a stroke of inspiration. She enthusiastically revealed its charming design to Hart only to receive another subdued reaction: "Cute." Noticing how he hastily averted his gaze, she realized her appeal was still lacking. Regardless, her innocent affection encouraged her to try harder next year.

name: Holy Sovereign
description: A version of Rune Sovereign with unique light trails for the holidays. As the genuine article is kept under maximum security deep below the surface, this is a replica Noel forged from memory. Although barely usable as a weapon, the shape is authentic, with added details of holly leaves around the hilt and snowflake patterns for magic circles. Imagining his emperor holding the original brought a smile to his face, and he could only hope he was watching over him now with the same smile.

name: Joining Blades "Snow-city"
description: Noel's interlocking swords festooned for the winter season. The custom of holiday celebrations have permeated into even the small town giving him refuge, and the shops are filled with bright trinkets. He places these next to a decorated replica of the emperor's sword. Despite knowing it is a brazen gesture, he believes the emperor would permit it. His only regret is being unable to share such a moment sooner, as snow falls for the first time on a Raktehelm without an Emperor Isliid.

name: Cane of Avidity "Wisdom Thirst"
description: A jeweled scepter described within the chronicles of the Isliid Library Ruins. It earned its name from the water-blue gem clutched by the shaft in the shape of a sorcerer's arm. Few theorize it is an actual limb severed by someone intent on seizing his magical talent. As ludicrous as this notion is, the depravity of Human greed across history lends it believability.

name: Human History "Lostpia"
description: Found upon the shelves of the Isliid Library Ruins. It contains the records of an unspecified Human nation that differs from the known customs and cultures of Isliid, Bamint, Gramenia, Famelle, and La Riiz. Scholars debate over two possibilities: there was a sixth country that no longer exists, or the text is pure fiction.

name: Sword of Reason "Máquina Interna"
description: A mechanized blade described within the chronicles of the Isliid Library Ruins. Vibrations induced by the network of spinning cogs enhances its cutting ability. Humans presumably invented this during the Ancient War. Being physically inferior to the other Races, they were forced to maximize efficiency in their killing implements.

name: Vials of Wisdom "Odd Mark"
description: Glass tubes described within the chronicles of the Isliid Library Ruins. They can convert even well water into a miraculous elixir overnight. The labels themselves contain no magic power, so the effect apparently comes from the inscriptions, since they were also used for sorcery in the Isliid region long ago.

name: Helmet of Quietude "Willseed"
description: A full helmet described within the chronicles of the Isliid Library Ruins. It is enchanted to block all outside interference, allowing the wearer to focus even against a throng of foes. Although this also means voices cannot be heard, those who believe words have no meaning in battle do not see it as a drawback. Rather, the argument over who will serve as the lone distraction will happen before it is donned.

name: True "Seventh Artemis"
description: The beloved weapon of Leone Templar and member of the Adventurers' Guild Reigrad branch Rosetta. It is also called the Star Crest Blade for the countless Crests engraved into the metal. As each one contains great power, most swords can only withstand a handful before shattering under the burden. The fact this holds far beyond the norm is thanks to the Prima Ether reinforcement technique of God sorceress Liza.

name: Star Crest Blade "Seventh Artemis"
description: The enchanted sword of Leone Templar and member of the Adventurers' Guild Reigrad branch Rosetta. Crests, letters imbued with the Ancients' power, are engraved into the metal. Invented by her after exhaustive research, she dramatically named it the "Star Crest Blade" due to how those Crests sparkled with each swing.

name: Comettail Dress "Alpen Stella"
description: The silver armor of Leone Templar and member of the Adventurers' Guild Reigrad branch Rosetta. She received it from the second princess of a certain principality as thanks for keeping her company. The elegant, novel design reflects its origin from a country of the arts. Although it has only adequate durability and resilience, she adores how light and stylish it is.

name: Cane of Stillness "Prying Dawn"
description: A staff with a golden jewel discovered in the skyward ruins of Famelle. The "stillness" in its name does not imply the importance of silence but how miracles are powered by unspoken will and not chanted words. It reads the wielder's mind and activates the spell as desired, creating a similar effect as limit casting mastered by a genius magician from Isliid. The difference is this does not demand his high-speed calculations.

name: God History "Legends"
description: An aged book discovered in the skyward ruins of Famelle. It holds the chronicles of Godkind, largely focusing on battles against the Demons. As such, they are portrayed as virtuous while all who oppose them are painted as evil. Although less accurate in comparison to other historic records, some scholars find value in how it establishes their self-image as flawless beings.

name: Sword of Flight "Heaven's Serena"
description: A silver weapon discovered in the skyward ruins of Famelle. The blade, shaped like layered feathers, is imbued with flying magic. It was originally made to allow aerial movement, but the speed required for that function also resulted in unavoidable attacks. A lack of caution -- or grip strength -- will cause what is called an Angel's Trick where it escapes the holder's hand mid-stroke.

name: Vials of Mystery "Hermit's Pain"
description: Glass bottles discovered in the skyward ruins of Famelle. These were actually brought into the ruins by a team of intrepid adventurers. Among them are a salve for deep wounds, a panacea for any condition, a solution to fill an empty stomach, and other potions suitable for a lengthy journey. However, preparation alone was not enough, as the corpses around this pouch attested.

name: Helmet of Providence "Allvisor"
description: A blessed kettle hat discovered in the skyward ruins of Famelle. It enhances one's sight to the degree of clairvoyance. When presented with world-encompassing vision, some wearers are overcome by the illusion of omnipotence. However, this is eventually shattered by the sheer volume of information inducing a motion sickness-like condition commonly seen among the uninitiated.

name: True "No Reply"
description: The mask of Misette, princess of the oldest life forms on Raktehelm, the Ancients. Its purpose is not defensive but restrictive, hampering her golden power that produced the Eight Great Races. Although its output is lowered to 0.0002%, she is still able to instantly create a huge arsenal, cross vast distances, and obliterate an army of thousands. Possessing might that exceeds even the Gods' comprehension, her epithet of "The Supreme Witch" is all too appropriate.

name: Lunar Mask "No Reply"
description: The mask worn by princess of the Ancients Misette. She is unable to remove it herself. It has three effects: restraining power, obstructing vision, and sealing memories. The memory seal is in tandem with the procedure carried out by the God sleeping inside of her. That doubled weight makes it easy to imagine the weight of truth hidden beneath should it come undone.

name: Cane of Corrosion "Deep Ray"
description: A staff with a dark jewel discovered inside the temple ruins of Gormarey. It gradually alters the holder's internal mana with every spell cast. When the conversion is complete, increased mana affinity allows it to use powerful arcana. This seems like a benefit, but the tampered mana is incompatible with other staves. Since this makes even simple magic impossible without it, those who rely upon it must be prepared to become totally reliant.

name: Demon History "Discord"
description: A weathered book discovered inside the temple ruins of Gormarey. It contains records of the Demons' wars. Of special note is the in-depth accounts of fallen fighters: their personalities, their final actions, and so on in minute detail. Those who sought power to stave off death eventually came to understand death's meaning. The focus on accomplishment and passing resembles the philosophy of Human warriors from the far east.

name: Sword of Corpses "War Cry"
description: A gnarled weapon discovered inside the temple ruins of Gormarey. It is fashioned from the strongest bone among thousands of cadavers. Rather than its sharpness, its weight and hardness are far more lethal. However, that very weight makes it difficult to handle. The name comes from the shout of exertion which usually accompanies hefting its mass.

name: Vials of Selection "Blind Test"
description: A set of glass containers discovered inside the temple ruins of Gormarey. They have a curious property when filled: three transform the contents into a lethal poison while the fourth transforms liquid into a miraculous medicine. As determining which is which can be nearly impossible, physicians cynically call it the Death Roulette.

name: Helmet of Isolation "Lunatic Lag"
description: A silver helmet discovered inside the temple ruins of Gormarey. The interior is isolated from the world outside, practically creating an entire world. This means attacks to the head, especially mind-control spells, are completely ineffective. In return, the wearer perceives time as running slower than normal, and this disparity with their physical actions frays at the nerves until insanity takes hold.

name: True "Earth Cry"
description: The superheavyweight weapon of Lazuli's military commander, Erens. When he swings it with his full might, it can alter the very landscape. Being manufactured by the company, it received no official name. However, its resultant tremors sounded as the very land groaning in the ears of his opponents, who gave it this informal appellation.

name: True "Grimm Stella"
description: A storybook overflowing with Selia's imagination. The forbidden "Literary Fragment" technique lets her freely materialize the fictional elements described in its pages, including mythological beings. The white bird that flies above the land of the dead, Ryougen Hakuhou, is one such monster. This ability to create matter from nothing resembles Misette's Golden Power.

name: Manuscript "Grimm Stella"
description: A storybook written by the Witch Selia. It contains a wealth of her tales, and she is able to bring the entities mentioned inside into reality. However, this technique requires the power of imagination, so she can only create what she can imagine. For example. since she dislikes celery, she cannot produce celery that would satisfy celery lovers.

name: True "Justice"
description: The sword given to the King Jayn Royal Memorial Academy Higher Education Division's student council secretary and disciplinary head. Its sharpness is incomparable to the other students' weapons. Being conscious of his position, he feels carrying a blade much stronger than the norm is unfair. However, the members are unanimous in their support, claiming that very notion makes him worthy of it.

name: Sword of Order "Justice"
description: The blade of Huma, one of Princess Echika's Four Schoolmates. It has a far sharper edge than the swords carried by other students. Combined with his outstanding technique, he is a match for a hundred opponents. This is not a metaphor; he actually triumphed over that exact number during a sparring session (cutting off one's armor counts as their loss). The feat also gave him his nickname of the Sword.

name: True "Amatsukado"
description: An exquisite sword from the far east wielded by Sumera-ryu master Emperor Isliid. Both incredibly sharp and lightweight, it perfectly suits the school's focus on swiftness. Word claims that enacting the secret technique Raiko with this weapon will produce an unavoidable attack surpassing the speed of light. None can verify the truth, yet none have been able to evade it.

name: White Flash "Amatsukado"
description: The brilliant sword of Emperor Isliid. The historic emperors passed it down along with their mastery of Sumera-ryu. The customary sun motif of the hilt lends it a grandeur equal to any of the Imperial Blades. Although seemingly meant for ceremonial use, it has been used in battle for ages. The alternate name of Mutant Slayer was earned by being the sole weapon that can pierce their flesh.

name: Sorcel Igniter MP2
description: The bracelet Valerie the adventurer wears as she travels alongside Rayas through Altohelm. An experimental medical device to address her innate mana deficiency, it provides what her body cannot produce. She can also choose to remove the limit and supersaturate herself with energy, pushing her physical abilities to their extreme.

name: Lunar Formality "Silenced Moon"
description: The dress uniform of Verzard, trusted retainer of Erath the Paraselene of the Great Six Demons. Imbued with unique magic, it aids him in controlling the Red World's power. He can exert an invasive effect over the real world using it. That strength is by nature too great for any of the Eight Great Races to command, but his ability to do so is one of many enigmas yet surrounding him.

name: Canaria's Full-Force Bikini
description: Worn during the Fenrir Corps' "heat acclimation training" on the beach. Although the design has a greater focus on cuteness than allure compared to other bikinis, wearing it still demanded bravery on her part. What she lacked in experience was compensated with all the effort she could muster, and she believed that effort would be rewarded. As for her anticipated reward...

name: Jay's High-Heaven Surfer
description: Worn during the Fenrir Corps' "heat acclimation training" on the beach. He tried surfing for a relatively honest reason: "Might impress the ladies." Indeed, his first attempt on the waves earned him the attention of every female along the shore. As the sun set, a swarm of women invited him to a nearby bar. One thing led to another, and by morning, he was begging his junior to borrow Gren yet again.

name: Merlette the Elegant
description: Worn during the Fenrir Corps' "heat acclimation training" on the beach. It was her secret weapon to win Jay's heart. Everything was manufactured to his tastes: the design, the exposure, and above all, the class. As he apparently distanced himself as of late, she hoped to close the gap in one fell swoop. If needed, she could even resort to skin contact. Her bold yet elegant battle had only just begun.

name: Azel's Red Ocean
description: What he wore during swim breaks while searching for treasure among the south islands. His purchase was settled from the moment he laid eyes on the falcon-shaped flame design. He flaunted it before arriving like a giddy child, putting off even Venna and Yuna. However, Firyl was pleased to see this yet-unfamiliar side to the captain.

name: Yuna's Heaven Holder
description: What she wore during swim breaks while searching for treasure among the south islands (despite not being invited). The white, wine-red, and black coloring brings to mind a fancy deck of playing cards. Azel, seeing that it was clearly made-to-order, recalled how embarrassed she was by Azel's prancing the day before and quipped, "Like you're any less excited."

name: Company-Issued Trunks L
description: What Firyl wore during swim breaks while searching for treasure among the south islands. These were provided by the Company for long-distance swimming practice. Azel mocked his lack of a personal style, but he found himself no less attached to them. The symmetric lines and wave-patterned accent along with the snug fit made for suitable performance. This summer, he was determined to not let others influence his preferences.

name: Riviera's Freedom Steps
description: Captain Riviera's beach sandals. Although she normally wears boots in preparation for rough seas and roughhousing, sometimes she'll sport these as if ready to enjoy a quick dip. Her shield-bearing crewman warns such exposure is dangerous, but she retorts that boots with a swimsuit is "weird". He briefly considers mentioning her insistence on wearing a swimsuit could also be seen as weird, but he defers to her (or his) preference.

name: Fen's Winged Accent
description: Fen, having returned to the beach to take his surfboarding to the next level, reveals this feather-shaped accessory around his waist. Its light blue color perfectly fits the tropical summer scenery. His fuzzy companion asks if the weight won't be a hindrance, but he just shrugs in response. Surfing is addictive because it is play. Anyone who seeks to master it must not forget that, and this represents his playful side.

name: True "Valistear"
description: The twin swords of hunter girl Atra. Left behind by the primordial Beast known as the Fanged Hunter, her tribe of those descendants used them for hunting across generations. Though they are formal implements of honorable origin, she will not hesitate to dissect game with them. She claims they conveniently slice through the toughest parts with ease. However, due to sanitary concerns, they are not brought out when cooking.

name: Brave Bow "Valistear"
description: The weapon of hunter girl Atra, said to be one of the armaments among the Legacy of the Fanged Hunter. A Meister of the Ancients developed this Ether-driven mechanical bow that could be split into a pair of blades. Attaching the handles to each other would reform the bow shape, but its mysterious construction shortens the two shafts into the length of one.

name: Miranda's Dark Matter
description: A substance she created while trying to make chocolate for Valentine's Day. The ooze inside the bowl wobbles and moans as if alive (what she calls "lovesick sighs"). Its formation is all the more baffling due to how it contains no unusual ingredients. Hart found its taste relatively normal, but he lost consciousness soon after swallowing. Anyone else who dares take a bite of this culinary surprise should have a remedy on hand.

name: True "Black Mass"
description: The gigantic weapon of undercover agent Simon. When loaded with an Origin Bullet cartridge, the scythe shifts into a mallet shape. Slamming the protruding tip into a target generates explosive force, enough for a certain kill according to the inventor's claims.

name: Soulcleaver "Black Mass"
description: The scythe Simon wields as the feared Undertaker. Capable of both slashing and bludgeoning, such sheer offensive focus gives it massive destructive potential. A single swing can annihilate most any foe. In his hands, this uncivilized weapon takes on a mystical aura.

name: True "Dark Prayer"
description: Simon's outfit order-made from the town tailor. The black color scheme and gothic styling show his commitment to living in the shadows and bearing his secret mission. Slits around the waist allow for quick movements while the belt anchors his torso for greater force in swinging his weapon.

name: Ultra-Emo Fusion Sword
description: The official name is "Ultra Emotional Fusion Sword". When the emotion of the two magical girls' hearts flare in unison, they can overlap Igniters to transform them into the "ultimate strongest" form. That edge of cleansing fire can annihilate any evil. Although it lives up to its "ultimate" label, the one shortcoming is how long it takes to meet the necessary conditions.

name: True "Emotion Igniter"
description: They are successor models of Professor Liza's Emotion Booster given to her younger sister Cestina (of the original Primawitches) during the battle against secret society Ghost a year ago. They were made to suit the new users, in colors of red and blue, to fight off the Muma Kingdom's sudden invasion.

name: Prima Flare Vacation
description: The swimsuit-style outfit worn by Charlotte after transforming in episode 16 of "The Magical Primawitches - Twin Fairies". This was its only appearance in the series, feeding on her desire to play on the beach. Although functionally identical to the usual outfit, Charlotte's Summer Passion Power increased its mana transmission speed, boosting the fusion sword's destructive force.

name: Prima Nova Dive
