description: The swimsuit-style outfit worn by Valerie after transforming in episode 16 of "The Magical Primawitches - Twin Fairies". This was its only appearance in the series, feeding on her longing to swim in the ocean. She was very fond of the design, going so far as to take selfies of herself modeling it in the cafe's break room after battle.

name: Henrietta's Royal Blue Bikini
description: She remembered having bought a similar article long ago. It was for the private inquiry of a tropical tourist spot, a secret mission with Sieg, Freed, and that other person. She chuckled to think about the fun they had, then her mind turned to how it was almost botched because of the two boneheads. That was enough to ever-so-slightly sour her mood.

name: Natasha's No-Prisoners Bikini
description: She thought about the concept of "cute". Henrietta told her to "pick a cute swimsuit", but she lacked the sense to recognize it. To her, functionality was all that mattered in clothing. After asking for the shop clerk's opinion, along with receiving some abrupt input from Henrietta, she ended up choosing this.

name: Emotion Igniter
description: Torch-shaped items invented by Professor Liza installed with second-generation transformational devices. They light the flame of emotion in the holder's heart to change her into a magical girl. The fire's shape can also shift into any weapon imaginable. The form of a blade is known as Sword Mode.

name: Ultra Relic "Petraskia"
description: A supernatural bow only obtained on rare occasions by those who defeat Inferno Dragon Degilmagna. Even fewer have used it, for it demands Godlike might to do so. Those who can are feared as demigod avatars of the Inferno Dragon. According to one regional fairy tale, the Winter of Thaumazein was ended by a single bolt from this bow, firmly establishing its reputation.

name: Ultra Relic "Zero = Recorder"
description: A supernatural instrument only obtained on rare occasions by those who defeat Azure Phoenix Freydal. Even fewer have used it, for it demands Godlike might to do so. Those who can are feared as demigod avatars of the Azure Phoenix. Minstrels have immortalized that power in song, telling how its melody of diamond dust could cover the entire world in a sheet of pure silver.

name: Ultra Relic "Benomopis"
description: A supernatural whip that rarely appears to those who have subdued Elpnuemas. As merely handling it demands God-like strength, none have mastered it use. Regardless, owning it is enough to become revered as the Dragon's demigod emissary. The barb at the end is coated in the same poison used to punish those who defile the sacred woods, rotting the flesh like overripe fruit.

name: Ultra Relic "Bleak Prophet"
description: A supernatural blade that rarely appears to those who have subdued Radachne. As merely handling it demands God-like strength, none have mastered it use. Regardless, owning it is enough to become feared as her demigod emissary. All of its victims are sent to the world of everlasting darkness where they will find sorrowful rest in the Insect Princess' embrace.

name: Ultra Relic "Eraser Bit"
description: A supernatural weapon that rarely appears to those who have subdued Code XTF: Eraser. As merely handling it demands God-like strength, none have mastered it use. Regardless, the very act of owning it is enough to command fear as an incarnation of slaughter. Many technicians have tried to reverse-engineer it, but a perfect reproduction has yet to be made.

name: Ultra Relic "Pteraturus"
description: A supernatural shield that rarely appears to those who have subdued Tonetaurus. As merely handling it demands God-like strength, none have mastered it use. Regardless, the very act of owning it is enough to command fear as an emissary of lightning. It gathers particles from the air to produce powerful shocks, reducing any weakling who touches it into ash. Whoever is able to carry this is a superior being worthy of ruling the world.

name: Ultra Relic "Empty Heart"
description: A supernatural substance that rarely appears to those who have subdued Oldeus. As merely handling it demands God-like strength, none have mastered it use. Regardless, the very act of owning it is enough to command fear as one who controls the fate of all life. It has Oldeus' power to summon the souls of the dead, but this is highly taboo for how it drastically affects the world.

name: Ultra Relic "Phantom Sword"
description: A supernatural sword that rarely appears to those who survive against Ragsherum Phantom. Since wielding it demands equally supernatural strength, the mere act of ownership makes one as feared as an undead creature. The many grudges inside eat away at the holder's heart, eventually transforming them into a true phantom.

name: Ultra Relic "Phantom Core"
description: A supernatural helmet that very rarely appears to those who survive against Ragsherum Phantom. Since wearing it demands equally supernatural strength, the mere act of ownership makes one as revered as a higher deity. When its true power is unleashed, the accumulated hatred of the Demons will burst forth, ravaging the world in a torrent of magic.

name: Ultra Relic "Bracchium"
description: Coming soon

name: Ultra Relic "Skeletooth"
description: Coming soon

name: Ultra Relic "Periusia"
description: A rare potion that can be obtained from defeating the enormous phoenix Flogassa. Though rumored to offer a power beyond mortal comprehension, the veracity of this is yet unclear since many who have taken it perished as a result. Whether it is panacea or poison, one thing for certain is whoever seeks strength must own it in sufficient measure as well. What is imperative is not a worthy cause but a will stout enough overcome the fear of death.

name: Scissor Blade
description: The scissor blade used by Ryuko Matoi. It was made in order to fight against Goku Uniforms and can cut Life Fibers. She only carries half of the scissor and, for some reason, she is searching for the one who holds the other blade.

name: Bakuzan
description: The favorite sword of Satsuki Kiryuin. For most weapons it is impossible to cut Life Fiber, but not for Bakuzan. This incredible ability is the result of the skill of Satsuki, who can unleash its fullest potential.

name: Fight Club Goku Uniform
description: The Two-Star Goku Uniform that was given to Mako Mankanshoku, the president of the Fight Club. She was originally considered a No Star student but unexpectedly revealed battle powers beyond imagination when wearing this Two-Star Goku Uniform.

name: Mako-Knuckle
description: The weapon chosen by Mako Mankanshoku, a student at Honnouji Academy. When wearing the Fight Club-Spec Two-Star Goku Uniform, she puts this knuckle on her fist to punch her enemies without mercy. Though a simple weapon that merely strengthens her fist's impact, its destructive power is extremely high.

name: Senketsu
description: The sentient black sailor uniform created by Ryuko Matoi's father, Isshin Matoi. It is made purely from Life Fiber which mere mortals cannot wear. It awakens and unleashes its power by absorbing Ryuko's blood. Only Ryuko can hear Senketsu's voice.

name: Junketsu
description: Another Kamui created by Ryuko Matoi's father, Isshin Matoi. Like Senketsu, it is made only from Life Fiber, which mere mortals cannot wear. The burden for the wearer, Satsuki Kiryuin, is so severe she cannot wear it for long.

name: Hero Cape
description: The cape that Saitama, a professional Hero, wears during his superhero activites.

name: Cyborg Arm
description: The mechanical arm of the S-Class Hero Genos. Countless weapons are installed inside.

name: Hero Gloves
description: The red gloves that Saitama, a professional Hero, wears during his superhero activites.

name: Hero Boots
description: The red boots that Saitama, a professional Hero, wears during his superhero activites.

name: Esper Dress
description: The trademark black dress worn by the S-Class Rank-2 Hero, Terrible Tornado.

name: Type 30 Arisaka Rifle
description: Saichi Sugimoto's trusted firearm. It was issued for the Imperial Japanese Army and was well regarded for its good accuracy and range. By attaching a bayonet to the end of the gun, it can also be used in close-range combat.

name: Sugimoto's Army Cap
description: The cap that Sugimoto always wears. It was worn by those in the Imperial Japanese Army, so it was quite common. For whatever reason, Sugimoto almost never takes his cap off.

name: Asirpa's Bow
description: The bow favored by Asirpa. Although it is very flexible, it is still quite tough. Poison coats the tips of the arrowheads. Once pierced by one of these poisoned arrows, even a brown bear would die within ten steps.

name: Asirpa's Bandana
description: The bandana always worn by the Ainu girl Asirpa. Ainu patterns are embroidered into its blue cloth.

name: Izumi no Kami Kanesada
description: The sword favored by Toshizo Hijikata. It is an absolute masterpiece of a sword that Hijikata has used since his Shinsengumi days. The sword was even kept in a bank safe as a work of art. It is said that Hijikata raided the bank to take back his sword.

name: Hijikata's Gun
description: A cutting-edge shotgun that Hijikata obtained from a foreign source. It contains up to 14 bullets and can be loaded with one hand, making it ideal for long gunfights. These features make it a very powerful weapon for close-range battles.

name: Snippity-Snips
description: The true form of Scissor Blade, a weapon created by Ryuko Matoi's father, Isshin Matoi. By cutting the Life Fiber from each side at the same time, it is possible to seal the strong regenerating power of the Life Fiber.

name: Guts
description: The pet dog of the Mankanshoku family. It wears a hoodie. He gets along well with Mataro, Mako Mankanshoku's younger brother and they often hang out together. He was named "Guts" because of how he always gorges on food.

name: Spiked Bat Missile
description: One of the weapons that Mako Mankanshoku used when she was the leader of the Fight Club. Also usable as a close combat weapon, this bat shoots powerful missiles from the end that leave a trail of thick smoke wherever they land.

name: Power Suit
description: A machine discovered in an ancient ruin. It is controlled from the inside, though practice is needed to effectively wield the induction guns on its arms. Despite its weaponry, it is believed to have been designed for a wide variety of uses like construction.

name: Vulture
description: A war machine discovered in some ruins. A modified version of the Power Suit believed to be specialized for battle. Equipped with remarkable flight ability and powerful artillery, its offensive capability is far beyond its original state. However, this makes controlling it that much more difficult, and those lacking a natural aptitude are unable to handle it at all.

name: Houtuan Bow
description: A weapon recovered from a newly discovered ruin. The arrowhead has a unique shape and is made of a strange ore called nanometal. Its unique properties grant it strength far beyond that of a standard arrow.

name: Hoverbike
description: A vehicle that flies through the air. With its real propulsion device and side attitude control devices, it can be maneuvered in a wide variety of ways. The cannon on the front gives it even greater utility, letting it be used for combat as well for scouting.

name: King Ghidorah
description: A device that allows one to summon the bringer of doom, King Ghidorah. With strength that rivals Godzilla, the mere mention of its forbidden name sends a chill down the spine. It is said to live in another dimension but can appear in other worlds at any time to seal their fate.

name: Rimuru's Sword
description: This is the Katana made for Rimuru by Kurobei, a Kijin blacksmith. It's highly efficient and even stops Gazel Dwargo's attack who is a dwarf king called a hero. Although Rimuru is learning sword skills under Hakuro, an old Kijin swordmaster also known as a savant, Rimuru's skills are still developing.

name: Milim's Necklace
description: The necklace that Milim, also known as "The Destroyer," wears. It is attached to her clothes, so it can also be counted as part of her clothes. Although it is made simple by just putting a string through three colored comma‐shaped beads, Milim's fashion itself is simple, so it seems that this necklace is just her taste.

name: Milim's Clothes
description: The clothes that Milim, the oldest Demon Lord, wears. The key point to her clothes is that it is quite revealing. Having both Demon Lord taste and childish tase to it, it suits Milim very well.

name: Benimaru's Clothes
description: The clothes that Benimaru wears. It was made for the battle between the Orc Lord by dwarf blacksmiths and Shuna, a Kijin girl. Hell Moth cocoon and Magicules are woven into the cloth, so it is long lasting and has high protection.

name: Rimuru's Clothes
description: The clothes that Rimuru wears during a fight. It was made by dwarf blacksmiths, Garm and Dord, and a Kijin, Shuna. It contains Magicule, so it is stronger than regular cloth and has high protection.

name: Magic-seal Mask
description: The mask that Shizue Izawa, a human from a different world and also known as "Conqueror of Flames" wore. After her death, Rimuru who is also a human from the same world of her has been wearing it. It can seal magic powers. Thus, when Rimuru wears it his Magicules are sealed and will not be recognized as a monster.

name: Benimaru's Sword
description: The katana that Benimaru, a young Kijin, uses. It was made for the battle between the Orc Lord by Kurobei, an excellent blacksmith. Benimaru's sword skills are extremely high since he had been learning sword skills from the swordmaster Hakuro from childhood.

name: Goblin Slayer's Sword
description: A cheap sword used by Goblin Slayer. It's rather short, but this makes it ideal to use in the narrow caves and holes where goblins live. Not to be sniffed out by the enemies, he never cleans it, and when it becomes unusable due to accumulated blood and flesh, he simply abandons it.

name: Goblin Slayer's Helm
description: This is the helm Goblin Slayer wears every day. Since he does the maintenance by himself, the broken horns remain unreplaced, and the scratches unbuffed. It hides his face completely, but the gaps allow his baleful red eyes to be seen.

name: Goblin Slayer's Dagger
description: Goblin Slayer uses this dagger to help him in his quests. He often uses it as a throwing weapon. He has dedicated all of his martial training to the slaying of goblins, and they say his blade throwing skills are extraordinary.

name: Sounding Staff
description: Priestess carries this holy staff with her daily. It is topped with the sacred symbol of the Earth Mother, and the staff itself is the same height as Priestess. When she uses her miracles, the gold rings sparkle with holy power.

name: Priestess' Robe
description: The sacred garb worn by Priestess. This is the usual robe worn by the devotees of the Earth Mother, adorned with designs fitting a holy servant of the Goddess. After Goblin Slayer recommended it, she began to wear chainmail underneath this robe. Now, she is deeply attached to it.

name: Priestess' Hat
description: This is a hat worn by those who dedicate their lives to the Earth Mother. Just like the robe, this hat is protected by divine power and helps defend the holy believer's good works. The design matches the robe, with a clean, simple appearance.

name: Elven Bow
description: This long-bow of durable wood is used by the High Elf Archer. The Archer herself often says that "Any sufficiently advanced skill is indistinguishable from magic" and her incredibly skilled shooting proves it right, as her arrows seem to move at her command.

name: Elven Cloth
description: The High Elf Archer wears this clothing on her adventures. It is light and well fitted, but it is made from materials that offer good defense in battle. In addition, her mantle hides the obsidian knives sheathed at her hips.

name: Demon Sword "Desiderium"
description: This demon sword was sealed in an ancient ruin. The sword in itself is mediocre, but it is filled with a magic power which allows the wielder to cut only what really has to be cut. An old story even narrates of an adventurer who slew many monsters killing only the evil spirits possessing them, but nobody knows if it is true. However, judging by the mysterious glow of the blade, everyone would believe that the story is true.

name: Hellish Blizzard's Necklace
description: The necklace worn by the B-Class Rank-1 Hero, Hellish Blizzard.

name: Hellish Blizzard's Coat
description: The coat worn by the B-Class Rank-1 Hero, Hellish Blizzard.

name: Hellish Blizzard's Dress
description: The dress worn by the B-Class Rank-1 Hero, Hellish Blizzard.

name: Sonic's Shuriken
description: The shuriken of Speed-o'-Sound Sonic. Using this weapon he unleashes his attack "Exploding Shuriken".

name: Sonic's Katana
description: The katana of Speed-o'-Sound Sonic. This extremely sharp blade is the weapon that fulfills Sonic's power.

name: Sonic's Mask
description: The trademark mask of Speed-o'-Sound Sonic.

name: Sonic's Scarf
description: The scarf of Speed-o'-Sound Sonic.

name: Crunchyroll-Hime's Bow
description: Once our frivolous Hime decided she wanted to be an adventurer, she knew she could never swing around a heavy sword. Oh no! She had to play the part of calculating camper, or archer! Thus, she asked her yokai friends to make her a bow, some arrows, and a quiver. When combined with her innate Kitsune Spirit, the weapon is unstoppable.

name: Crunchyroll-Hime's Boots
description: You've never seen more sturdy boots! Hime moves faster than the Speed of Japan, and some strong boots are necessary for the amount of land she's covering. Wearing these boots will make you feel like you can run non-stop for days, without breaking a sweat.

name: Crunchyroll-Hime's Clothes
description: Hime watched one-too-many isekai anime, and decided she needed adventurer's clothing! Sudachi, Hime's younger sister, spent weeks making an outfit for her elder sister. The costume is imbued with sisterly-love, and anyone wearing it will feel a boost of evergy!

name: Ryuko's Bomber Jacket
description: The favorite jacket of Ryuko Matoi, a girl who transferred to Honnouji Academy. Not only is it her favorite outfit, but it is also made strong and firm despite not using Life Fibers.

name: Nudist Beach Battle Uniform
description: The battle uniform (female ver.) of Nudist Beach, an organization that opposes the threat of Life Fibers. Being a rebel organization, they hardly or never wear any clothes and instead wear this battle uniform and fight to free humans from clothes.

name: Priestess' Boots
description: These are the boots of Priestess, who dedicates her life to the Earth Mother. Once saved by Goblin Slayer, she followed his advice and purchased useful equipment. These boots fit her very well, and she takes excellent care of it. These beautiful boots representing her dignity as a priestess tells us how much her and Goblin Slayer are prepared for their adventures.

name: Goblin Slayer's Shield
description: This is the small shield that a man called Goblin Slayer favored. At first glance, it looks like an ordinary shield, but it is excellent for fighting in small places such as tunnels. It is convenient in areas with obstacles and also to be used as a weapon. Thanks to its high versatility, it is perfect for Goblin Slayer, who likes simple but strong equipment.

name: Small Shield
description: The sacred treasure that Naofumi Iwatani, the Shield Hero, received as one of the Four Holy Heroes. It is one of the Legendary Weapons that is passed to Melromarc's protectors. It enhances in proportion to the Hero's level and there are various ways of enhancing its abilities. It is possible to insert materials and recipes into the shield to enhance it further. The shield also has a translator, enabling Naofumi to understand the languages of other worlds.

name: True Small Shield
description: The sacred treasure that Naofumi Iwatani, the Shield Hero, received as one of the Four Holy Heroes. It is one of the Legendary Weapons that is passed to Melromarc's protectors. It enhances in proportion to the Hero's level and there are various ways of enhancing its abilities. It is possible to insert materials and recipes into the shield to enhance it further. The shield also has a translator, enabling Naofumi to understand the languages of other worlds.

name: Raphtalia's Sword
description: Raphtalia's Sword of choice. She changed to this sword from her knife when she leveled up. She got it at the blacksmith that owed Naofumi Iwatani favors. Made out of magical iron, she has used it to protect Naofumi by slashing any enemy that stands in their way.

name: True Raphtalia's Sword
description: Raphtalia's Sword of choice. She changed to this sword from her knife when she leveled up. She got it at the blacksmith that owed Naofumi Iwatani favors. Made out of magical iron, she has used it to protect Naofumi by slashing any enemy that stands in their way.

name: Raphtalia's Bracelet
description: Raphtalia's bracelet that Naofumi Iwatani made for her. He endowed it with magic-enhancing powers.

name: Filo's Hairpin
description: Filo's hair accessory that Naofumi Iwatani made for her. He endowed it with speed-increasing powers and chose to make it a hairpin since it was unlikely to fall off when Filo transforms...so he says.

name: Melty's Dress
description: Melty's plain dresswear of choice. Its elegant design perfectly matches the second princess' noble tastes.

name: Puu
description: A Spirit Realm Beast that uses Yusuke Urameshi's heart as his life force. His cute appearance belies his immeasurable potential. Since Puu's life is linked to his master Yusuke's, changes in Yusuke's condition are also reflected in Puu's body. This helps Puu notice right away when there is danger, so that he can fly straight to his master's side. Puu is greatly influenced by his master's heart, leading him to do things like using barriers to protect his allies from evil Demonic Energy.

name: The Sword of Trials
description: A shapeshifting sword given to Kuwabara by the Beautiful Suzuki. At first glance, it just looks like a sword handle, but it was made with a type of plant from the Demon World which grows by absorbing energy from its surroundings, and the handle can take the form of a powerful blade in response to the user's energy and emotions. Kuwabara was afraid of this sword at first, but when he overcame that fear, he obtained a blade of unparalleled strength. However, the user of the blade must pay a dangerous price for its power.

name: Kurama's Whip
description: A cut rose that turns into a whip when Kurama imbues it with Demonic Energy. The whip has the lovely fragrance of a rose, and its tip pierces through enemies like a thorn. Kurama can even detect the location of his enemies using the scent coming from the whip. With the way Kurama uses fragrance to control fights and sometimes even manipulates his own hair as a whip, it would not be an exaggeration to say that his striking appearance is just like that of a rose.

name: Hiei's Sword
description: The sword used by Hiei, the bandit who acquired the Jagan Eye. Its edge is sharp even without the power of Demonic Energy. When coupled with Hiei's expert sword technique, it can slice through all enemies in an instant. Hiei placed so much trust in this sword that when its blade was broken during a battle, it became a vessel for the Sword of the Darkness Flame using Hiei's fiery Demonic Energy. Hiei's swordsmanship would not be the same without this sword. Although it is unclear who the swordsmith is, this sturdy and streamlined blade is quite apt for the solitary Hiei.

name: Older Toguro
description: The elder of the two Toguro brothers. He, like his brother, is a Yokai who used to be a human. He has the power to shapeshift, manipulating his body to use it as a weapon, as well as an incredible ability to heal. He sometimes turns his own body into a sword or a shield so that his younger brother can use him to torment their enemies. The perfect synchronization between the two brothers is a result of their many years together, and now that they have become Yokai, their connection is only growing stronger. Of course, the elder Toguro brother is incredibly powerful even when on his own.

name: Type 30 Bayonet
description: An Imperial Army bayonet used by Sugimoto Saichi. While it can be attached to the tip of a rifle, it can also be used as a handheld sword or a regular knife too. This bayonet has survived death many times with Sugimoto, to the point that it could be considered a part of his body.

name: Asirpa's Hunting Knife
description: Asirpa's beloved tashiro, a kind of Ainu hunting knife. It can be used for anything from cooking to crafting tools needed in the mountains. It is incredibly versatile when used with the knowledge of the Ainu people, which has been passed down from generation to generation.

name: Hijikata's Clothes
description: The clothing worn by Toshizo Hijikata of the Shinsengumi during the last days of the Tokugawa shogunate. The Merciless Vice-Commander, as his nickname goes, is sprightly despite his age and wields his sword in these Western-style garments. When Hijikata puts these on, he gives off an incredible air of dignity.

name: Hero Belt
description: The belt worn by the strongest hero Saitama. The golden buckle shines brightly, even today.

name: Hero Suit

name: Roswaal Mansion Maid Uniform
description: The uniform centerpiece for servants of the Roswaal household. For some reason, there is a lot of female stock but male uniforms are in scarce supply.

name: Rimuru's Santa Suit
description: A Christmas outfit prepared by the people of Reigrad for Rimuru. Although it was made to thank Rimuru for defeating the beasts, it was very uncomfortable that the people thought Rimuru was very cute in the outfit.

name: Milim's Santa Coat
description: A Christmas outfit prepared by the people of Reigrad for Milim. She likes how cute the low-cut hem makes her look. Several men approached her with unsavory expressions, but they all came to regret it moments later.

name: Shion's Santa Dress
description: A Christmas outfit prepared by the people of Reigrad for Shion. Although it was made to thank her for helping save the town, it was obviously meant to be more a gift for themselves than her. Regardless, she seemed unaware of their intent and wore it proudly.

name: Milim's Thigh-Highs
description: Long stockings prepared by the townspeople to match Milim's Santa outfit. Made from magical fabric, they allow her to more easily control her own strength. It was the most thoughtful choice after hearing how many times her unrestrained power has caused problems...

name: Gourikimaru
description: A huge sword carried by Shion. Few can withstand its overwhelming strength. When she offered to slice a fish to help with the Christmas cooking, it seemed she also cut through the table and even left a large dent in the floor...

name: Milim's Winter Boots
description: Cute red boots prepared by the townspeople to match Milim's Santa outfit. Despite how they look, they are sturdy enough to defend against any attack, mostly her own.

name: Rimuru's Haori
description: Rimuru made this based on past New Year memories after seeing Reigrad's celebration. Though an unfamiliar design in Raktehelm, its dignified look left an impression on the other men. There are even rumors they'll adopt it for future New Year's festivals.

name: Milim's Kimono
description: A kimono made by Rimuru to match own New Year's Haori. Its low-cut design lets her move easily, so she likes it quite a lot. This sentiment is shared by the other ladies of Reigrad, starting up a new fashion trend.

name: Milim's Zori
description: A pair of Japanese style shoes made by Rimuru to match own New Year's Haori. They are made of steel with magical power to withstand the power of the rampaging Milim. As a result, they are very heavy, and only Milim can wear them.

name: Dragon Knuckle EX
description: Made by Rimuru to restrain Milim's strength. It has a weakening effect to hold her crushing might in check. The equipment used its full potential to keep the city from being destroyed, during the battle in Raktehelm

name: Rimuru's Scarf
description: Rimuru made this based on past New Year memories after seeing Reigrad's celebration. It was originally just an accessory to complete the look with own Haori, but Rimuru truly appreciates its high defensive power and warmth.

name: Milim's Kanzashi
description: A hairpin Rimuru made for Milim to match own New Year's Haori. Though she wasn't comfortable with her new look at first, she soon came around since it was a gift from him.

name: NEGI
description: The favorite vegetable of the electronic diva Hatsune Miku. It won't break after millions of swings, always staying fresh and springy. It doesn't actually exist in her world; she received it from a higher being called The Maestro. In her hands, it moves at a steady tempo like a conductor's baton.

name: Miku's Headphones
description: The fashionable headphones of electronic diva Hatsune Miku. They contain the memories of The Maestro. Whenever she gives a performance with her beautiful voice, she always puts on these first.

name: Miku's Outfit
description: The costume of electronic diva Hatsune Miku. It draws out her natural charm with its chic, cute design. Made with advanced technology, it lets her create a wide variety of sounds like an instrument from her world. It is said to give any singer who wears it the power to pierce the hearts of all living things with their song. Some believe this is because of an enigmatic feature called "absolute territory" but not even she knows for certain.

name: Rin Plushie
description: A plush doll of Kagamine Rin, a singer with a girlish voice. Although she looks like the spitting image of Kagamine Len, she wears a large, cute ribbon. It was brought to Raktehelm by Hatsune Miku, who supports them both as a senior and as a fan. Cuddling it is believed to melt away exhaustion in an instant, and many also enjoy finding ways to pose it with the matching Len Plushie.

name: Len Plushie
description: A plush doll of Kagamine Len, a singer with a boyish voice. Although he looks like the spitting image of Kagamine Rin, he sports a cool hairstyle. He has many who enjoy his energetic singing. It was brought to Raktehelm by Hatsune Miku, who has more experience than them but still supports their efforts. In their world, a mere picture can cheer up his fans.

name: Miku's Guitar
description: The signature guitar of electronic diva Hatsune Miku. Once belonging to a higher being known as The Maestro, it was converted so she could play it after seeing how she loved its color. The sound when she first played it for The Maestro, while she was still an amateur singer, is still vivid in her memory. It is said that its cheerful, dazzling tones can capture the heart of any who hear it.

name: Sakura Miku's Hair Charm
description: Hair accessories worn by Miku when she announced spring's return. There is a special tree in her world that symbolizes the start of the season, and these were designed after the fruit that grows on them. When she puts them on, her hair color changes from her usual blue-green to the cheerful pink of cherry blossoms. Her singing voice can then create warm, refreshing breezes that carry petals far and wide. The day she visited Bamint, they saw spring like they had never seen it before.

name: Sakura Miku's Outfit
description: The clothes worn by Miku when she saved Bamint from the Giants' winter. While she sang in the capital city, spring flowers began to bloom and bright colors emerged, as if she were unfurling a blanket of warmth all around her. That day, she left her mark on Bamint's history as the Spring-Calling Fairy.

name: True "Shield of Rage"

name: Raphtalia's Outfit

description: The boots she wears after transforming into a magical girl. They are sturdy enough to support her nimble movements, faster than the eye can follow.

name: Sayaka's Sword
description: The weapon she uses as a magical girl. A knuckle guard is placed over the grip on the same side as the blade's edge. She uses it to launch quick, upclose raids.

name: True "Kyoko's Lance"
description: The weapon she uses as a magical girl. Elastic and multi-jointed, it can transform as she needs to attack from any angle and range. Her combat sense draws out its full potential.

name: Kyoko's Dress
description: The dress she wears after transforming into a magical girl. It is deep red in color with a priest-like design. The jewel placed over the chest appears to contain her condensed prayers.

name: Kyoko's Boots
description: The boots she wears after transforming into a magical girl. The diamond-and-cross pattern creates a gothic look, and they can withstand her acrobatic maneuvers.

name: Kyoko's Lance
description: The weapon she uses as a magical girl. Elastic and multi-jointed, it can transform as she needs to attack from any angle and range. Her combat sense draws out its full potential.

name: True "Reimu's Purification Rod"
description: The evil-cleansing rod of a shrine maiden in paradise. She swings it to drive away yokai or sometimes split them clean in two.

name: True "Marisa's Broom"
description: A straw broom that reflects an ordinary magician's taste. She normally flies by riding on it. Leaves spouted from the shaft after absorbing her magic power.

name: Reimu's Purification Rod

name: Reimu's Clothes
description: The bright red-and-white outfit of a shrine maiden in paradise. The open-shouldered design was brought about by detaching the sleeves.

name: Reimu's Ribbon
description: The red ribbon of a shrine maiden in paradise. Its size and design establishes her trademark look.

name: Marisa's Broom
description: A straw broom that reflects an ordinary magician's taste. She normally flies by riding on it. Leaves spouted from the shaft after absorbing her magic power.

name: Marisa's Hat
description: A black, wide-brimmed hat that looks very much the part of an ordinary magician. The big, star-studded ribbon highlights her bold spirit.

name: Marisa's Dress
description: A simple black dress and white apron. Combined with her hat, it embodies the ideal concept of an ordinary magician.

name: True "Roukanken"
description: The longer katana of the half-phantom gardener. Forged by yokai, it possesses incredible cutting power. A single swing can supposedly kill ten phantoms.

name: True "Yuyuko's Fan"
description: The folding fan of Hakugyokurou's mistress. Dyed in an eye-catching lilac hue, the graceful dances as she holds it change her image from calm to majestic and charismatic.

name: Hakurouken
description: The shorter katana of the half-phantom gardener. It has the power to cut confusion, letting phantoms pass on to the heavenly realm.

name: Roukanken
description: The longer katana of the half-phantom gardener. Forged by yokai, it possesses incredible cutting power. A single swing can supposedly kill ten phantoms.

name: Youmu's Dress
description: A turquoise vest and skirt over a white shirt worn by the half-phantom swordswoman. There is a spirit mark over the left side of her chest. She does not find spirits frightening, but ghosts are.

name: Youmu's Hairband
description: Worn by the half-phantom swordswoman. Its black color gives her a sharp look that suits her attitude. The ribbon adds a touch of charm.

name: Yuyuko's Fan
description: The folding fan of Hakugyokurou's mistress. Dyed in an eye-catching lilac hue, the graceful dances as she holds it change her image from calm to majestic and charismatic.

name: Yuyuko's Kimono
description: The outfit of Hakugyokurou's mistress. The blend of styles gives it a dress-like appearance. The wispy impression is helped by its billowy sky-blue sleeves.

name: Yuyuko's Hat
description: The headdress of Hakugyokurou's mistress. Its ruffled brim gives it the appearance of a nightcap. The triangular band indicates her status as a ghost.

name: Flandre Plushie
description: Based on the younger of the vampire sisters in the Scarlet Devil Mansion. The simplified detail still shows her innocence and danger.

name: Remilia Plushie
description: Based on the older of the vampire sisters in the Scarlet Devil Mansion. The simplified detail still shows her arrogance and extravagance.

name: Sakuya Plushie
description: Based on the head maid of the Scarlet Devil Mansion. The simplified detail still shows her elegance and coolness.

name: True "Rimuru's Spring Hat"
description: A rabbit-eared top hat for the Bounding Bunny Bash with ears crafted to sway realistically in the wind. Rimuru was somewhat against them, but they looked so good on the Demon Lord that no one could understand why.

name: True "Milim's Bunny Headband"
description: The attached rabbit ears are made from a soft, flexible material and move like real ears such as Zephyr's.

name: Rimuru's Spring Hat
description: A rabbit-eared top hat for the Bounding Bunny Bash with ears crafted to sway realistically in the wind. Rimuru was somewhat against them, but they looked so good on the Demon Lord that no one could understand why.

name: Rimuru's Spring Suit
description: A white and blue uniform for the Bounding Bunny Bash. The fringe where the cape attaches to the shoulders shows the intricacies of Falfanian style along with the choice fabric.

name: Rimuru's Spring Boots
description: White footwear made for jumping in the Bounding Bunny Bash. The fur along the ankles helps cushion impact, but it was originally added as a cute decoration.

name: Slime-Mark Egg
description: Drawn with a likeness of Rimuru's slime form by the BBB's head organizer. Milim is particularly fond of the design, ensuring it will never leave her possession.

name: Milim's Bunny Headband
description: The attached rabbit ears are made from a soft, flexible material and move like real ears such as Zephyr's.

name: Milim's Pastel Streamers
description: The pink fur and plethora of frills met her standards for the ultimate in cuteness, but the price was apparently rather high.

name: Milim's Breezy Step
description: One thigh-high stocking with pink and white stripes, a heart-adorned garter belt, and a fluffy pair of boots. They were tough enough to withstand her mountain-surpassing leaps, making the mountain seem weaker in comparison.

name: Slime-Mark Wreath
description: Awarded for outstanding performance in the Bounding Bunny Bash. The accessory shaped like slime-form Rimuru adds a cute touch. Naturally, Milim claimed ownership at first opportunity.

name: Swirl-Dyed Egg
description: An egg painted in the colors of Benimaru, Shuna, Shion, and Soei. Whether or not Shion's hue appears poisonous depends on the viewer.

name: Spring Surprise
description: A present for Rimuru from the BBB's head organizer. It contains dolls resembling Rimuru's group. Veldora's is noticeably larger than the rest, protruding from the package in an amusing fashion.

name: True "Demon Monarch's Dagger"
description: Obtained after defeating the Demon Monarch Baran, one of Jinwoo's most devastating weapons. Imbued with an intimidating aura, he uses it to unleash a flurry of attacks in the blink of an eye.

name: True "Hae-In's Rapier"
description: A lightweight blade with a pointed tip. Made to be held in one hand, it still boasts phenomenal sharpness. She uses it to live up to her reputation as the Dancer by performing incredible feats with grace.

name: Demon Monarch's Sword
description: Obtained after defeating the Demon Monarch Baran, an unusually long weapon in the arsenal of dagger-wielding Jinwoo. With girth and aura befitting an overlord, it can cause massive destruction.

name: Demon Monarch's Dagger
description: Obtained after defeating the Demon Monarch Baran, one of Jinwoo's most devastating weapons. Imbued with an intimidating aura, he uses it to unleash a flurry of attacks in the blink of an eye.

name: Jinwoo's Clothes
description: A stylish but unassuming outfit to help him lay low. Far from eye-catching, they no less embody his desire to seek greater power.

name: Kasaka's Venom Fang
description: A dagger obtained when Jinwoo defeated the Blue Venom-Fanged Kasaka by breaking through its tough scales. In addition to high attack power, it possesses paralysis and drain effects.

name: Knight Killer
description: A dagger Jinwoo purchased from the system's shop. It inflicts additional damage to armored magic beasts.

name: Hae-In's Armor

name: True "Jong-In's Cloak"
description: A flowing cape in a mature, calming burgundy. The golden shoulder guards protect and grant an impactful weight. As there are no sleeves, he has full range of movement to cast whatever spell he needs.

name: True "Igris' Claymore"
description: A sword nearly as long as he is tall. Only one of his talent can handle its heft. How it shares his blue and black color scheme shows that he and it have become one.

name: Jong-In's Glasses
description: His signature black-rimmed spectacles. They both match his suit and give him an air of intelligence.

name: Jong-In's Suit
description: The outfit he wears into battle. Unlike his violet business suit, this one is in brilliant white to reflect his prestigious title as the ultimate weapon.

name: Jong-In's Cloak

name: Igris' Claymore

name: Igris' Armor
description: Highly protective layers of metal that perfectly cover the body. Even if an attack lands, he can withstand it effortlessly. The deep red hair-like decoration on the helmet was the origin of his title before he became a shadow.

name: Iron's Axe
description: A ponderous weapon held in his right hand. One side has a sharp edge and the other forms a hammerhead. This ability to both slash and crush with a single implement is suitable for one of his might.

name: Iron's Shield
description: A barrier he holds in his left hand. Large enough to cover half of his body, it absorbs nearly any attack. It symbolizes his status as a defensive keystone.

name: Puck Plushie
description: Resembles the great cat spirit which protects Emilia as her guardian. Life-sized but will not get mad at being touched like the real thing.

name: Subaru's Whip
description: Subaru named it "Guiltywhip". He practiced whip techniques to make more tricks and tactics available to him, a survival strategy that he polished after careful consideration of how he can fight.

name: True "Rem's Spiked Flail"
description: The Morningstar she wields. It reacts to the demonified Rem's power, magnifying its terrible destructive might. Specialized for offense, she can swing the spiked ball to strike within the chain's reach whether close or mid-range.

name: True "Witch of Greed's Dress"
description: As black as funeral clothes. It matches with Echidna's white hair to create a charming contrast that accentuates her beauty.

name: Ram's Staff
description: What she uses as a weapon when casting magic. It is compatible with her style and sharpens precision.

name: Witch's Tea
description: What Echidna offered Subaru during her tea party in the Sanctuary. It was made from her own body fluids, but he was not told that until after gulping it down. His reaction was predictably agitated.

name: Witch of Greed's Dress
description: As black as funeral clothes. It matches with Echidna's white hair to create a charming contrast that accentuates her beauty.

name: Beatrice's Tome of Wisdom
description: Instructed her on what to do by telling the future. It eventually stopped updating, the final pages left blank.

name: Petelgeuse's Robe
description: The clerical outfit of Petelgeuse Romaneeconti, the Sin Archbishop in the Witch Cult representing Sloth. Although nearly identical to the standard robes, it seems to augment his wicked aura.

name: True "Rune Sovereign Type: Illya"
description: The original Crest Blade, said to cut through matter, time, space, and consequence. Unable to grasp its overwhelming might, she uses it simply to defend those dear to her.

name: True "Mercurius Type: Miyu"

name: Dark Bringer Type: Illya
description: The Imperial Sword of Conquest with an immense effect against Demons. When fighting against one of great size, Liza suggested she use it from among her various weapons.

name: Terra Master Type: Illya
description: The Imperial Sword of Command, the only one that felt slightly cold in Illya's hand. She has yet to tell anyone of this.

name: Illya's Imperial Outfit
description: An outfit resembling the omnipotent Emperor Isliid she gained after Installing. The dignified figure of the man who once reigned over the world's largest nation is no less reflected in her slight body.

name: Mercurius Type: Miyu
description: The Magistone scepter of God princess Liza. It lent power to her by fusing with Magical Sapphire to make Mercurius Sapphire.

name: Miyu's Divine Outfit
description: The outfit of the Starstream Witch Liza she gained after Installing. Although not from this world, the similar styling suits her perfectly.

name: Zwei Form Stick
description: An enhanced magic wand formed by the combination of Magical Ruby and Magical Sapphire. When the power of one is not enough, the bonds of two will make things possible.

name: True "Zanketsu Type: Chloe"
description: Templar Captain Vox's katana involuntarily recreated via Tracing. Though not as keen as the original, it is incredibly sharp. When she fights with her full strength, it shifts into Overedge state.

name: True "Caladbolg II"
description: An imitation of a weapon from Celtic mythology created with Shirou's expert projection magecraft. It is inferior to the original yet no less capable of destroying other Heroic Spirits.

name: Enkidu
description: The Noble Phantasm of Gilgamesh, said to have once constrained the Bull of Heaven. It can suppress any sort of resistance to ensnare the target.

name: Heroic Spirit Emiya's Bandana
description: The simple red design speaks of his own approach in fighting for his ideals.
